SEO – On-page (18)

  • SEO Page InspectorPaste HTML source: full on-page report with prioritized issues.
  • Heading Structure AnalyzerHeading hierarchy tree, missing H1, skipped levels, empty headings.
  • Image SEO AuditAlt text, dimensions, lazy loading, format and filename audit from HTML.
  • Open Graph & Twitter Card ValidatorValidate OG and Twitter card tags from pasted HTML.
  • JSON-LD InspectorExtract JSON-LD from HTML and sanity-check required properties.
  • Link Extractor (internal / external)Classify links from pasted HTML: internal, external, nofollow, anchor text.
  • Text-to-HTML RatioVisible text vs. total HTML size.
  • Accessibility HTML LintBasic accessibility checks on pasted HTML (not a full WCAG audit).
  • SERP Snippet PreviewGoogle-style preview with estimated pixel widths and truncation warnings.
  • Title / Description Length CheckerCheck many titles or descriptions at once (one per line).
  • HTML Head Extractor (Meta, Link, Title Table)List every title, meta, link and base element in the head of pasted HTML in one table, with duplicates and missing basics flagged.
  • Social Image Size Checker (Open Graph)Choose an image and check its pixels, aspect ratio and file size against Facebook and LinkedIn link-preview guidance. Nothing is uploaded.
  • Canonical Conflict Checker (canonical, og:url, hreflang)Compare the canonical link, og:url, twitter:url and hreflang self-reference in pasted HTML and show where they disagree.
  • Meta Refresh Redirect DetectorFind meta refresh tags in pasted HTML, show delay and target, how Google reads them, and the equivalent 301 or 302 server rule.
  • Duplicate Title and Meta Description Finder (Crawl CSV)Load a crawl export CSV (Screaming Frog style) and group the URLs that share the same title or meta description. Download the groups as CSV.
  • Bulk Title Truncation Preview (CSV)Check many titles at once: estimated pixel width, desktop and mobile cut-off, and where the ellipsis would fall. Edit the list and re-run to test rewrites.
  • Legacy Meta Tag Remover (meta keywords and more)Strip the meta keywords tag and other obsolete meta tags from a pasted head block, and list exactly what was removed.
  • Multilingual Title Width Checker (CJK, Thai, Arabic, Cyrillic)Estimate title pixel width per script and see where each title would be cut off. CJK glyphs are about twice as wide as Latin ones.

SEO – Content (36)

  • Readability ScoresFlesch, Flesch-Kincaid, Gunning Fog, SMOG, Coleman-Liau, ARI.
  • Keyword Density1-3 word phrase frequency and density.
  • Keyword ExtractorExtract key phrases from text (RAKE-style scoring).
  • Content Gap (Term Comparison)Compare terms in two texts: what a competitor covers that you miss.
  • TF-IDF Term RankerRank distinctive terms in document 1 against others (separate docs with a line ---).
  • Keyword Placement & Content Score CheckerPaste a page (HTML or text) and a target keyword: check title, description, H1, URL, first paragraph, alt text, density and length, with a score.
  • AI Search (GEO) Readiness CheckerRule-based check of a page for answer-engine friendliness: question headings, answer-first passages, structure, citations, author and date signals, snippet controls.
  • E-E-A-T & Freshness Signal CheckerScan page HTML for visible trust signals: author, credentials, dates, about/contact links, citations, organization data and review markup, plus content age.
  • Text Summarizer (Extractive, No AI Model)Pick the most representative sentences from an article using TextRank or word-frequency scoring. Runs in the browser, no model download.
  • Text Similarity & Duplicate Content CheckerCompare two texts: word-shingle Jaccard, cosine similarity and the longest shared phrases. Local duplicate-content check, not a web plagiarism scan.
  • Blog Headline & Title Idea Generator (Templates)Turn a topic into dozens of headline ideas from proven patterns (how-to, list, question, guide, comparison), each with a length check. Template based, no AI.
  • Meta Description Suggester (Extractive)Paste a page or article and get three meta description candidates built from its own best sentences, trimmed to a safe length. Rule based, no AI.
  • Tone of Voice Analyzer (Lexicon Based)Score text for formality, confidence, urgency, positivity and directness using word lists and sentence statistics. English only, no model.
  • Article Text Extractor (Readability-Style Main Content from HTML)Paste a web page's HTML and get just the article: title, author, date, reading time and the main text as plain text or Markdown, with navigation, ads, comments and footers removed. Works offline.
  • Content Freshness Audit (Outdated Years, Versions and Time Phrases)Paste an article or page and find what has gone stale: old years, "this year" and "recently" phrases, software versions, statistics without a date, copyright year and COVID-era wording. Gives a refresh checklist.
  • Thin Content Detector (Unique Words per Page)Paste several pages: shows total and unique words per page after removing text shared by most pages (menus, footers), and ranks the thinnest.
  • N-gram Extractor: Most Frequent 2, 3 and 4-Word PhrasesFinds the most repeated two, three and four word phrases in a text, with counts, without crossing sentence breaks. Choose how stop words are handled.
  • Keyword Permutation Generator: Combine Word ListsPut two to four lists of words in separate blocks (separated by a blank line) and get every combination, optionally in all column orders. Up to 50,000 results.
  • Keyword List Cleaner: Remove Duplicates, Stop Words and Near-DuplicatesCleans a keyword list: lowercase, trim, strip symbols, drop exact duplicates, optionally drop stop words and near-duplicates (same words in another order, simple plurals).
  • Question Keyword Extractor: Filter a Keyword List to QuestionsKeeps only the question-style keywords (who, what, how, can, is ...) from a list and groups them by question word, ready for FAQ and how-to content.
  • Content Decay Finder: Pages Losing Clicks Between Two Search Console ExportsPaste the Pages export from Search Console for an earlier and a later period. Lists pages that lost clicks, with impression, position and CTR changes and a hint about the likely cause.
  • Passive Voice and Long Sentence CheckerFlags sentences that look passive ("was written by") and sentences that are too long, with counts and percentages. A heuristic for English text, not a grammar parser.
  • Content Brief Builder from Competitor HeadingsPaste the headings of top-ranking pages (HTML or Markdown, one block per page) and get a brief: topics most pages cover, questions asked, common terms, typical length of the outline and a draft outline.
  • Featured Snippet Formatter: Paragraph, List or Table AnswerReshape an answer into a short paragraph, an ordered or bulleted list or a table, with clean HTML under a question heading. Checks length against common rules of thumb.
  • Keyword Difficulty Estimator from Competitor Metrics You EnterTurn the authority and link counts of the pages ranking for a keyword into a 0 to 100 difficulty score with a simple, shown formula, and compare it with your own site.
  • Search Volume Seasonality Chart from Monthly DataPaste monthly search volumes (from a keyword tool, 12 or more months) and see a text bar chart, a seasonal index per month, peak and low months and the swing between them.
  • SERP Position CTR Model: Estimate Clicks from Target RankingsEstimate monthly clicks from search volume and ranking position with a click-through curve you can edit. Compare current and target positions and see the possible gain.
  • Transliteration Keyword Tool: Cyrillic, Greek and Japanese Kana to LatinTurns Russian, Ukrainian, Greek or Japanese kana keywords into Latin-letter spellings, with an optional URL-slug form. A simplified rule-based romanization, not an official standard.
  • Adverb and Weak Qualifier HighlighterMark -ly adverbs and weak words like very, really, just and quite in your draft, with counts and a rate per 100 words.
  • Cliché and Overused Phrase DetectorMark clichés and worn-out phrases in your text using a built-in list of about 80, with counts.
  • Jargon and Buzzword Detector with Plain AlternativesFlag corporate buzzwords like leverage, synergy and circle back and see a plainer word for each.
  • Repeated Word Finder (Same Word Used Too Close Together)Find words that come back within a few words or sentences of each other, ignoring common little words, and mark them in your text.
  • Headline Capitalizer: AP, APA, Chicago and MLA Title CaseCapitalize a headline in AP/APA style (lowercase words of three letters or fewer) or Chicago/MLA style (lowercase all short function words), or switch to sentence case.
  • DOI Extractor and Link Builder (Check DOI Syntax)Find DOIs in pasted text or a reference list, clean them up and build doi.org links. Checks the syntax only; it does not look anything up.
  • ISBN Validator and ISBN-10 / ISBN-13 ConverterCheck the check digit of ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 numbers and convert between the two forms. Works offline; it does not look up the book.
  • Gender-Coded Language Checker for Job AdsFlag gendered job titles and words often described as masculine- or feminine-coded in job adverts, with neutral alternatives.

SEO – Technical (110)

  • robots.txt TesterTest URLs against robots.txt with longest-match, wildcard and $ rules.
  • Sitemap ValidatorCheck limits, duplicates, bad URLs, dates and values in pasted sitemap XML.

  • Redirect Chain Analyzer (from curl -IL output)Paste the headers from curl -sIL or browser dev tools and see every hop, status, loop and SEO issue (302 where 301, http to https, long chains).
  • RSS / Atom Feed ValidatorCheck pasted RSS 2.0 or Atom XML for well-formedness and required elements, dates, links, GUIDs and enclosures.

  • Web Server Access Log Analyzer: Status Codes, Top URLs, BotsPaste Apache or nginx combined-format log lines to see status codes, top URLs, 404s, slowest-growing paths, search and AI crawler activity and bot hits by status. Local analysis.
  • Anti-bot and WAF Detector (from Pasted Headers, Cookies and HTML)Paste response headers, cookies and page source and see which bot protection, WAF or CAPTCHA the site uses: Cloudflare, Akamai, DataDome, HUMAN, Imperva, Kasada, reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha and more.
  • HTML Link Auditor (Broken Anchors, Empty Links, nofollow, Generic Anchor Text)Paste page HTML and audit every link offline: empty and javascript: hrefs, fragment links with no target, http links on https pages, _blank without noopener, nofollow and sponsored, generic anchor text and duplicates.
  • Soft 404 Detector (Error Page That Returns 200)Paste a page's HTML and its HTTP status to see if it looks like a soft 404: error wording, thin content, noindex, a canonical to the home page, a meta refresh redirect. With advice on 404, 410 or 301.
  • Mobile-Friendly HTML Check (Viewport, Tap Targets, Fixed Widths)Paste page HTML and run static mobile checks: viewport meta, zoom blocking, fixed pixel widths, tiny fonts, media queries, tables and images wider than a phone, plugins and tap-target hints. No rendering, no upload.
  • Search Console Page Indexing Report Explainer (Why Pages Are Not Indexed)Paste the reasons table from Search Console "Pages" (Why pages aren't indexed) and get each reason explained, rated normal or needs-action, with the fix, sorted by page count.
  • CrUX and PageSpeed Insights Field Data Analyzer (Core Web Vitals p75)Paste the JSON from the Chrome UX Report API (query or history) or PageSpeed Insights loadingExperience and get Core Web Vitals pass or fail, p75 vs thresholds, good/needs-improvement/poor shares and trend.
  • robots.txt Validator (RFC 9309 Syntax Check)Parse a pasted robots.txt and flag syntax errors, unknown directives, misspellings, bad paths, size and encoding problems.
  • robots.txt Diff Viewer (Rule Changes per User-agent)Compare two versions of a robots.txt and see added and removed rules per user-agent, ignoring comments, blank lines and order.
  • robots.txt Viewer: Grouped Rules per CrawlerRead a pasted robots.txt as a plain-English summary: which crawlers are named, what each may not fetch, sitemaps and ignored lines.
  • robots.txt Size Checker (500 KiB Limit)Measure a robots.txt in bytes against the 500 KiB crawler limit and show which line a crawler stops reading at.
  • robots.txt Wildcard Pattern Tester (* and $)See which sample URLs a robots.txt pattern such as /*.pdf$ or /shop/*?sort= matches, with the regular expression it stands for.
  • robots.txt Allow / Disallow Conflict DetectorFind Allow and Disallow rules that overlap in the same group and show which one wins for each overlap.
  • robots.txt User-agent Group Merger (Effective Rules)Show the rules each crawler really follows after groups with the same user-agent are merged, and that the * group is not added on top.
  • Bulk robots.txt URL Checker (CSV Export)Test hundreds of pasted URLs against a robots.txt for one or more crawlers and export blocked and allowed results as CSV.
  • Crawl-delay Calculator (Requests per Day)Turn a robots.txt Crawl-delay value into maximum requests per hour, day and month, and see which crawlers read it.
  • robots.txt Encoding and Invisible Character CheckerFind byte order marks, invisible characters, look-alike symbols and non-ASCII paths that make crawlers ignore robots.txt lines.
  • robots.txt Minifier (Strip Comments and Duplicates)Make a robots.txt smaller without changing what crawlers do: remove comments, blank lines, duplicate rules and merge groups for the same user-agent.
  • robots.txt Formatter (Casing, Spacing, Order)Tidy a robots.txt: consistent directive casing, one space after the colon, a blank line between groups, optional sorted rules and misspellings fixed. Comments are kept.
  • robots.txt to JSON ConverterConvert a robots.txt into structured JSON: groups with user-agents and rules, sitemaps, other directives and ignored lines.
  • robots.txt Sitemap Line Extractor and CheckerList every Sitemap line in a robots.txt and check that each is an absolute URL, not duplicated and not mixing http and https.
  • robots.txt Blocked CSS, JS and Image CheckerCheck whether robots.txt blocks the CSS, JavaScript, image and font files a crawler needs to render your pages.
  • Staging robots.txt Left on Production CheckerDetect a blanket Disallow: / (and noindex on the page) that was pushed from staging to production, or a staging site that is not blocked.
  • Unsupported robots.txt Directives Detector (Noindex, Host, Crawl-delay)Flag lines such as Noindex, Nofollow, Host and Crawl-delay that Google ignores, with what to use instead.
  • robots.txt Pattern to Regex Converter (for Log Analysis)Convert robots.txt Allow and Disallow paths with * and $ into regular expressions for grep, awk, BigQuery or log tools.
  • robots.txt URL Lister (http, https, www and Subdomains)List the robots.txt URL for every host variant (http, https, www, non-www, each subdomain) you need to check, because each has its own file.
  • Googlebot robots.txt Rule Simulator (Parser Edge Cases)Test URLs the way Google reads robots.txt: accepted typos, group merging, 500 KiB cut-off, ignored directives and the least-restrictive tie-break.
  • Bingbot robots.txt Rule Simulator (Compared with Googlebot)Test URLs for Bingbot, show its Crawl-delay and see where the result differs from Googlebot because of group selection.
  • Crawl Budget Waste EstimatorEstimate the share of crawler requests spent on parameter, facet and duplicate URLs, and how long a full crawl of your real pages takes.
  • robots.txt HTTP Status Code Explainer (200, 301, 404, 429, 503)See how Google and RFC 9309 treat each HTTP status code returned for robots.txt: success, redirect, 4xx unavailable and 5xx unreachable.
  • TDMRep JSON Validator (/.well-known/tdmrep.json)Validate a tdmrep.json file against the W3C TDM Reservation Protocol: array shape, location patterns, 1 or 0 values, policy URLs and rule order.
  • Sitemap Size and Limit CheckerCount URLs and bytes in a sitemap against the 50,000 URL and 50 MB limits, see the percentage used and how many files you would need.
  • Gzipped Sitemap Reader (.xml.gz)Open a sitemap.xml.gz in your browser: unzip it, see formatted XML, URL count and size, and save it as plain .xml.
  • Sitemap Diff (Added, Removed, Changed URLs)Compare two sitemaps or URL lists: URLs added, removed and changed (lastmod, changefreq, priority, images). Also finds pages missing from a sitemap when you paste a crawl or archive list.
  • News Sitemap Freshness CheckerShow the age of each article in a Google News sitemap and list the entries older than 48 hours that you can remove.
  • Sitemap Lastmod Date ValidatorCheck every lastmod in a sitemap for W3C datetime format, impossible or future dates, missing values and the tell-tale "all URLs share one date" pattern.
  • Sitemap to CSV ConverterTurn sitemap XML into a CSV with loc, lastmod, changefreq, priority and, when present, image, video and hreflang columns.
  • Sitemap URL Pattern and Structure AnalyzerGroup sitemap URLs by folder and URL template to see site structure, section sizes, parameter variations and very deep paths.
  • Sitemap vs robots.txt Cross-CheckList the sitemap URLs that robots.txt blocks for a chosen crawler, with the rule that blocks each one.
  • Sitemap Non-Canonical URL FinderFlag sitemap URLs with query strings, fragments, tracking parameters, mixed http/https or www, uppercase, index files or odd trailing slashes, each with a suggested clean form.
  • Search Console Page Indexing Export AnalyzerPaste Search Console page-indexing exports (CSV): totals per reason, and URLs grouped by reason and by top folder to show which sections lose the most pages.
  • Sitemap Priority and Changefreq DistributionCount how often each priority and changefreq value appears in a sitemap and show it as a bar chart, so meaningless defaults stand out.
  • Sitemap Lastmod TimelineChart how many URLs were last modified per day, month or year, find single-day spikes and see which folders are stale.
  • Pagination Link and Canonical CheckerReview a paginated series from pasted HTML: self-referencing canonicals, canonical pointing to page 1, prev/next consistency, fragment links and noindex.
  • Rendered vs Raw HTML SEO Diff (JavaScript-Injected Tags)Paste the view-source HTML and the rendered DOM: lists the title, canonical, robots, headings, links and structured data that only exist, or change, after JavaScript runs.
  • JSON-LD Syntax ValidatorParse JSON-LD with exact line and column errors, then check @context, @type and @id. Accepts raw JSON or a whole HTML page.
  • Schema.org Property CheckerCheck each JSON-LD property against the Schema.org vocabulary for its @type, with did-you-mean suggestions and superseded warnings.
  • Rich Result Eligibility CheckerCompare JSON-LD with Google required and recommended properties for Article, Product, Recipe, Event, Job, Video, Review and more.
  • Schema Deprecation CheckerFlag JSON-LD types whose Google rich results were retired or limited (FAQ, HowTo, special announcement and more), with the changelog date.
  • Microdata to JSON-LD ConverterConvert schema.org microdata in pasted HTML into JSON-LD. Nested itemscope elements become nested objects, itemref is followed.
  • RDFa to JSON-LD ConverterConvert RDFa (vocab, prefix, typeof, property, resource) in pasted HTML into JSON-LD with full schema.org types.
  • Structured Data ExtractorPull JSON-LD, microdata and RDFa out of pasted HTML into one tree, with each item also printed as copyable JSON-LD.
  • Schema Graph VisualizerDraw the @id references in JSON-LD as a node diagram with a table. Broken references and disconnected nodes are marked.
  • Schema Markup DiffCompare two JSON-LD versions and list added, removed and changed properties by path. Key order and whitespace are ignored.
  • Hreflang Code Checker (ISO 639-1 and 3166-1)Check hreflang values against the ISO 639-1 language, ISO 3166-1 region and ISO 15924 script lists. Gets en-UK, jp and es-419 right.
  • Declared Language vs Page Text CheckerGuess the language of pasted text from its script and common words, and compare it with the lang or hreflang code you declared.
  • HTML lang, Content-Language and Hreflang Consistency CheckerCheck the html lang attribute, meta content-language and Content-Language header against the page self-hreflang and each other.
  • Hreflang Audit from a CSV ExportAudit a crawl export of hreflang annotations: self-references, missing return links, non-200 targets, canonical conflicts and bad codes.
  • Hreflang Cluster VisualizerDraw hreflang annotations as a graph: arrows between pages, one-way links dashed in red, pages without a self-reference marked.
  • Hreflang Sitemap Validator (xhtml:link)Validate xhtml:link hreflang annotations in sitemap XML: namespace, codes, self-reference, return links and duplicates.
  • RTL Layout and Bidi Checker for Arabic and Hebrew HTMLCheck dir and lang on right-to-left HTML, and flag Latin text, numbers, URLs and physical CSS that may need bdi, dir or logical properties.
  • Search Console Wrong-Locale Traffic Checker (CSV)Paste a Search Console export of clicks by page and country and see how much traffic each language version gets from outside its market.
  • HTTP Status Codes: What Each Means for SEOSearch the common HTTP status codes and see how Google Search treats each one: indexing, crawl rate, redirect strength. Notes marked "not covered" are not in Google's documentation.
  • Redirect Type Advisor: 301, 302, 307, 308 or Meta RefreshPick the situation and get the redirect status code to use, why, and what to watch for. Based on how Google Search treats each code.
  • Bulk Redirect Rule Generator: Apache, Nginx, Cloudflare, Netlify, VercelPaste old and new URLs and get redirect rules for Apache (Redirect, RedirectMatch, RewriteRule), Nginx (location or map), Cloudflare Bulk Redirects CSV, Netlify _redirects or vercel.json.
  • Redirect Map Flattener: Find Chains and Loops in a Redirect ListPaste your old to new redirect pairs. Finds chains (A to B to C) and loops, and gives rules that point every old URL straight at its final destination.
  • HTTPS, www and Trailing Slash Redirect Rule Builder (Apache, Nginx)Build the rules that force HTTPS, one preferred host (www or non-www) and one trailing slash policy, in a single hop where possible. File URLs are left alone.
  • URL List Normalizer and DeduplicatorClean a URL list so equal URLs look equal: host case, default ports, dot segments, percent-encoding, parameter order, tracking parameters, slashes. Then remove or group duplicates.
  • URL Sorter and Folder Counter: Sort URLs by Path and DepthSort a URL list by folder, group it under its directories and see a count for each folder and each depth level. Good for sitemap and crawl exports.
  • Regex URL Tester: Match a Pattern Against a URL ListTest one regular expression against many URLs at once. Shows which match, which do not, capture groups and an optional replacement, for redirect rules and analytics filters.
  • Redirect Rule Tester: See Which Rule Matches a URLPaste your redirect rules (Apache Redirect and RedirectMatch, Nginx rewrite and one-line location, Netlify style wildcards) and test URLs to see the matching rule, status and final destination.
  • 404 Page Generator: Helpful Not Found Page with Search and LinksBuilds a single-file, accessible 404.html with a clear message, a search box and your popular links. Light and dark mode, no scripts, no external files.
  • DNS Answer Comparer: Compare Two Resolver Results After a ChangePaste dig output (or record lines) from two resolvers, or from before and after a DNS change, and see what matches, what differs and which TTLs disagree.
  • Domain Migration SEO Checklist: Redirects, Search Console, SitemapsTick off a site move step by step: preparation, URL mapping, redirects, Change of Address and follow-up. Progress is saved in this browser only.
  • URL Length Checker: Sitemap, Apache and Nginx LimitsCheck URL length in characters and bytes against the sitemap limit (2,048), the default Apache request line limit and the default Nginx header buffer, plus your own limit.
  • Case Sensitivity URL Checker: URLs That Differ Only by Letter CaseFind URLs in a list that are the same except for upper and lower case. On case-sensitive servers they can be separate duplicate pages. Gives the lowercase version to redirect to.
  • Crawl Error URL Grouper: Find Patterns in 404 and Error URL ListsPaste URLs from a Search Console export, a crawler or a log. Groups them by folder, URL pattern, file type or query parameter so you can fix a whole class of errors at once.
  • Googlebot Crawl Budget Analyzer (Hits by Section, Template and Day)Paste access log lines and see how many Googlebot requests go to each site section or URL template, with status codes and hits per day.
  • Orphan Page Finder: Bot-Crawled URLs Missing From Your URL ListCompare the pages bots request in your access log with your sitemap or crawl export, and list crawled pages that are in neither.
  • Uncrawled Sitemap URLs Report (Never Requested by Bots in the Log)List the sitemap URLs that no selected bot requested during the log period, grouped by folder, with coverage per folder.
  • Crawl Frequency per URL (Hits and Days Since Last Bot Visit)See how often each URL was requested by a bot, when it was first and last seen, the average gap between visits and days since the last visit.
  • Bot Status Code Report (2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx per Crawler)Break down the HTTP status codes your server returned to each crawler, list exact codes and show the URLs behind most errors.
  • Wasted Crawl Detector (Parameters, Facets, Redirects, Errors in Logs)Group bot requests into likely waste: error pages, redirects, faceted and parameter URLs, tracking and session parameters, internal search and thin pages.
  • Redirect Hits in Logs (URLs Bots Keep Requesting That Redirect)Find the URLs that crawlers request again and again and that answer with 301, 302, 307 or 308, ranked by hits, so you can fix the links that point to them.
  • robots.txt Fetch Monitor (Bot Requests, Status and Timing from Logs)Pull every crawler request for /robots.txt out of your log with status code and response time, plus a fetch count per day and bot.
  • Crawl Depth vs Bot Hits (URL Path Depth)Count bot requests and distinct URLs by path depth (number of folders) to see where crawling thins out on your site.
  • New Content Discovery Lag (Publish Date to First Bot Visit)Measure how long a bot took to request each new URL for the first time, from your publish dates and your access log.
  • Googlebot Smartphone vs Desktop Split Over TimeChart Googlebot smartphone against desktop requests per day from your log, with image, video and other Google crawlers counted apart.
  • Bot Response Time Report (Slow Sections and URLs for Crawlers)Show how long your server took to answer crawlers, per section or URL template, with median, 95th percentile and the slowest URLs.
  • Crawl Spike and Drop Alerts from Access LogsFlag days when bot request volume jumps or falls compared with the previous days, per crawler or in total.
  • Log vs Search Console Crawl Comparison (Paste-In)Compare daily Googlebot hits counted in your access log with the daily crawl requests you copied from the Search Console Crawl stats report.
  • AI Bot Training vs Retrieval Splitter (from Access Logs)Split AI crawler requests in your log into training, search indexing and user-triggered fetches, per bot and per purpose.
  • Resource Crawl Report (CSS, JS, Images, Fonts Requested by Bots)See how often crawlers fetch pages, CSS, JavaScript, images, fonts and data files, with the status codes each file type received.
  • Hreflang Alternate Crawl Coverage (Are All Language Versions Crawled?)Check in your log whether bots requested every language version of a page, using hreflang groups you paste.
  • Canonical vs Crawled URL Mismatch (Bot Hits on Non-Canonical URLs)Find URL variants that declare a different canonical URL but still receive bot requests, using a crawl export you paste next to the log.

Privacy – Images (3)

  • EXIF / Image Metadata ViewerParse JPEG EXIF (camera, dates, GPS) and PNG/WebP chunks with a hand-written parser. File never leaves your browser.
  • EXIF / Metadata RemoverRe-encodes images through a canvas so EXIF, GPS, XMP and text chunks are dropped. Keeps JPEG/PNG/WebP format. Multiple files supported.
  • Image Redaction (blur / black boxes)Load an image, drag boxes over sensitive areas, fill them black or pixelate, export. Metadata is stripped on export.

Privacy – Secrets (18)

  • Password GeneratorCryptographically random passwords (crypto.getRandomValues, no modulo bias). Guarantees each selected class appears.
  • Passphrase GeneratorPronounceable syllable-based passphrases from crypto.getRandomValues. Entropy is computed exactly from the syllable space.
  • Password Strength CheckerEntropy, patterns (common passwords, l33t, keyboard walks, sequences, repeats), and crack-time estimates. Runs only in this page.
  • Secret Detector & RedactorFind AWS/GCP/GitHub/Slack/Stripe keys, JWTs, private keys, credentials in URLs and high-entropy tokens. Report plus redacted output.
  • PII RedactorRedact emails, phones, IPv4/IPv6, MAC, credit cards (Luhn), IBAN (mod-97), SSN / Belgian NN, and tokens in URLs.
  • Log Privacy WorkbenchRedact PII and secrets from logs, then group similar lines (timestamps, ids and numbers normalised) with counts and levels.
  • URL Tracker StripperRemove utm_*, fbclid, gclid, msclkid, mc_eid and 60+ other tracking parameters from a list of URLs (or URLs inside text).
  • AES-GCM EncryptEncrypt text with a password: PBKDF2-SHA256 (600k iterations) + AES-256-GCM via WebCrypto. Output is base64: version | iterations | salt | iv | ciphertext.
  • AES-GCM DecryptDecrypt output from the AES-GCM Encrypt tool with the same password. Authentication failure means wrong password or tampered data.
  • TOTP Generator (RFC 6238)Generate time-based one-time codes from a base32 secret or otpauth:// URI, with a live countdown. Computed locally with WebCrypto.
  • Random Secret / Token GeneratorHex, base64, base64url, UUID v4, alphanumeric or numeric tokens from crypto.getRandomValues.
  • .env LinterFind plain-text secrets, duplicates, missing quotes, weak/default values, invalid lines and risky settings in a .env file. Nothing is uploaded.
  • .env ToolkitDiff two .env files (values masked), convert .env <-> JSON, or generate a safe .env.example.
  • Pwned Password Range Matcher (k-anonymity, Offline)Hash a password locally, get the 5-character prefix to look up yourself, then paste the range response here to see if the suffix appears. The password never leaves the page.
  • SQL Injection Pattern Scanner (Logs & Inputs)Scan access-log lines or form values for SQL injection signatures (tautologies, UNION SELECT, time-based and error-based payloads), URL-decoding first. Signature based, runs locally.
  • Code Security Scanner (Rule-Based, Local)Paste code in JavaScript, Python, PHP, Java, Go, Ruby or C and flag risky patterns: eval, XSS sinks, SQL concatenation, shell injection, weak hashes, hard-coded secrets, disabled TLS checks. Regex rules, with CWE ids.
  • Email and IP Hasher for Pseudonymized UploadsNormalize emails or IP addresses (trim, lowercase, optional plus-tag removal) and hash each line with SHA-256, SHA-384 or SHA-512 plus an optional salt. Runs in your browser.
  • IP Address Anonymizer (Truncate IPv4 and IPv6)Zero the host part of IPv4 and IPv6 addresses in a list or in whole log lines. Choose how many bits to keep. Timestamps and other text stay unchanged.

Privacy – Browser (22)

  • Browser Fingerprint TestSee what a tracker can read without cookies: UA, screen, canvas/WebGL/audio hashes, fonts, hardware. Computed locally, nothing is sent.
  • WebRTC Local IP Leak TestCheck which local network addresses your browser exposes to any page through WebRTC. No STUN server is contacted, so nothing leaves your device.
  • Browser Capabilities & Privacy InfoFeatures, client hints, storage quota, permission states, privacy signals (DNT / GPC) and connection info read from your own browser.
  • User-Agent ParserBreak a User-Agent string (one per line) into browser, engine, OS, device, CPU, bot flag, with notes on UA reduction.
  • Tracker Detector (HTML source)Paste page source: find third-party trackers, analytics, ad pixels, social widgets, fonts and CDNs by domain list and inline code signatures.
  • Cookie Flag AnalyzerPaste Set-Cookie headers: checks Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite, __Host-/__Secure- prefix rules, lifetime, scope and known tracking cookies.
  • HAR Privacy AnalyzerPaste HAR JSON: third-party domains, trackers, cookies and Set-Cookie flags, mixed content, large/slow requests, header mismatches. Stays in your browser; HAR files contain secrets so never upload them elsewhere.
  • CSP BuilderBuild a Content-Security-Policy header from a preset plus extra sources. Outputs header, meta tag, nginx and Apache lines.
  • CSP AnalyzerPaste a Content-Security-Policy: flags unsafe-inline/eval, wildcards, data:/http: sources, JSONP-able CDN hosts, missing object-src/base-uri/frame-ancestors, typos, and gives a grade.
  • Invisible Character & Homoglyph DetectorFind and strip zero-width, bidi-control and other invisible characters, plus Cyrillic/Greek look-alikes mixed into Latin words. Useful against text watermarking and spoofing.
  • Hacked Page / Injected Code ScannerScan pasted HTML for signs of a hack: hidden iframes and links, obfuscated eval, redirects, miners, spam words. Pattern based, local only.
  • Browser Permissions Viewer (What This Site Is Allowed To Do)List the state of every browser permission for this site (location, camera, microphone, notifications, clipboard, sensors, MIDI...) using the Permissions API, without asking for anything. Updates live.
  • Cookie Classifier (Necessary, Analytics, Marketing)Paste cookie names (or Set-Cookie / Cookie lines) and sort them into necessary, functional, analytics and marketing using a built-in name list. Unknown names are marked for review.
  • Consent Mode gcs and gcd DecoderPaste Google tag request URLs or the gcs and gcd values and see the consent state for ad_storage, analytics_storage, ad_user_data and ad_personalization.
  • IAB TCF v2 Consent String DecoderDecode a TC string (euconsent-v2) into dates, CMP id, purposes with consent or legitimate interest, vendor ids, publisher restrictions and extra segments.
  • IAB GPP String Decoder (Global Privacy Platform)Decode a Global Privacy Platform string: header, section ids, plus the contents of the EU TCF v2, US Privacy and US National sections. Other US state sections are listed only.
  • US Privacy String (CCPA usprivacy) DecoderDecode a legacy 4-character CCPA US Privacy string such as 1YNN into notice given, sale opt-out and LSPA covered transaction. Shows what each position means.
  • Global Privacy Control Signal TesterShows whether this browser sends the Global Privacy Control signal (navigator.globalPrivacyControl) and Do Not Track, and how a site is expected to react.
  • Third-Party Domain Classifier (Vendor and Category)Paste domains or URLs and see the vendor and category of each: analytics, advertising, social, session replay, fonts, CDN and more. Unknown domains are listed for review.
  • Pre-Consent Request Finder (HAR)Paste a HAR recorded on first visit before clicking the banner. Lists tracker requests and cookies set before consent, in time order.
  • Cookie Expiry Auditor (13-Month Limit Check)Paste Set-Cookie headers and flag cookies whose lifetime is longer than a limit you choose, 13 months by default as in CNIL guidance. Reads Max-Age and Expires.
  • Google Fonts Loading Checker (Self-Hosting Guide)Paste HTML or CSS and find remote Google Fonts requests: link tags, @import, preconnect. Lists the font families and weights and gives a self-hosting plan with @font-face stubs.

Privacy – Legal (23)

  • Privacy Policy Generator (GDPR / CCPA)Fill in the options to get a privacy policy draft covering GDPR and/or CCPA/CPRA. Template only, not legal advice.
  • Cookie Policy GeneratorCookie policy draft with a categorised table of cookies (necessary, preferences, analytics, marketing). Template only, not legal advice.
  • Terms of Service GeneratorWebsite / SaaS terms and conditions draft with optional accounts, payments, user content and liability clauses. Template only, not legal advice.
  • Cookie Consent Banner GeneratorSelf-contained HTML/CSS/JS banner (accept, reject, choose categories). Choice is saved in localStorage. It does NOT block scripts by itself: you must gate them on consent.
  • GDPR Erasure / Access Request LetterGenerate an Art. 17 erasure and/or Art. 15 access request letter to a company. Template only, not legal advice.
  • GDPR Compliance ChecklistInteractive GDPR self-assessment checklist. Progress is saved in your browser (localStorage) only.
  • Cookie Table Builder for a Cookie PolicyTurn a list of cookies, purposes and durations into a cookie policy table grouped by category. Missing categories are guessed from the cookie name.
  • Consent Banner Compliance ChecklistTick what your cookie banner does and get a list of items to review: equal reject button, no pre-ticked boxes, granular choices, withdrawal and more. Checklist, not legal advice.
  • Google Consent Mode v2 Snippet BuilderGenerate the gtag consent default and update code with ad_storage, analytics_storage, ad_user_data and ad_personalization, plus optional region and wait_for_update.
  • Global Privacy Control Script Gate (JavaScript Generator)Generate JavaScript that checks navigator.globalPrivacyControl before loading the third-party scripts you list, plus the matching Sec-GPC server check.
  • Record of Processing Activities (GDPR Art. 30) BuilderBuild an Article 30 record of processing as a table. One processing activity per line; missing Art. 30(1) fields are flagged for review.
  • DPIA Screening Questionnaire (Is a DPIA Needed?)Tick which of the nine EDPB/WP29 high-risk criteria apply to a processing activity and get a screening result: DPIA likely required, consider one, or document why not.
  • Data Subject Request Response Template GeneratorGenerate a controller reply to a GDPR request: access, erasure, portability, rectification, restriction or objection, with versions for fulfilled, partly refused, ID check and extension.
  • DSAR Deadline Calculator (GDPR and CCPA)Enter the date a data subject request arrived and get the response deadline with the extension: one month plus two under GDPR Art. 12(3), 45 days plus 45 under CCPA.
  • GDPR Lawful Basis Selector (Article 6)Answer yes or no for each Article 6(1) basis and see which ones could fit your purpose, with the checks to make for each and a note on special category data.
  • Data Retention Schedule BuilderTurn data categories, retention periods, triggers and justifications into a retention schedule table. Flags empty justifications and open-ended periods.
  • Privacy Law Applicability Checker (GDPR, UK GDPR, LGPD, CCPA)Tick facts about your business and see whether GDPR, UK GDPR, Brazil LGPD and California CCPA/CPRA may apply, with the reason and the source article for each.
  • EU Cross-Border Data Transfer Checker (Adequacy or SCCs)Enter destination countries and see whether the EU has an adequacy decision for them or whether you need safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses. Offline list with a date.
  • Privacy Policy Readability GraderPaste a privacy policy and get word count, reading time, Flesch scores, long sentences and a count of vague phrases such as "may" and "third parties".
  • Privacy Contact Page and privacy.txt GeneratorBuild a privacy contact page (HTML) and a security.txt-style text file listing DPO, privacy contacts, request form and policy links. The text file format is not a standard.
  • Impressum Generator (German and Austrian Legal Notice)Fill in company details and get a German or Austrian site notice (Impressum) in German or English, with register, VAT ID, authority and responsible-editor sections.
  • Click-to-Load Embed Wrapper (YouTube, Maps, Social)Paste an iframe embed and get a placeholder with a button that loads the embed only after the visitor clicks. Optionally swaps YouTube for the youtube-nocookie domain.
  • GDPR Breach Notification Timer (72 Hours) with Draft NoticeEnter when you became aware of a personal data breach and get the 72-hour Art. 33 deadline, time left and a draft notification with the four required points.

JSON (35)

  • JSON FormatterPretty-print JSON with custom indent and optional key sorting; errors show line and column.
  • JSON MinifierRemove all whitespace from JSON (validates first).
  • JSON String EscapeEscape text so it can be embedded inside a JSON string.
  • JSON String UnescapeTurn an escaped JSON string (\n, \", \uXXXX) back into plain text.
  • JSON ValidatorCheck whether text is valid JSON and see its structure.
  • JSON Tree ViewerBrowse JSON as a collapsible tree, search keys and values, click a key to copy its path.
  • JSON Key SorterSort object keys alphabetically at every level.
  • JSON DiffCompare two JSON documents and list differences by path.
  • JSON to CSVConvert an array of JSON objects to CSV, flattening nested values into dotted columns.
  • JSON to XMLConvert JSON to XML. Keys starting with @ become attributes, #text becomes text content.
  • JSON to YAMLConvert JSON to clean block-style YAML.
  • JSON to TOMLConvert a JSON object to TOML (tables and arrays of tables). TOML cannot represent null.
  • JSON to TypeScriptGenerate TypeScript interfaces or types from a JSON sample, merging array elements.
  • JSON to Go StructGenerate Go structs with json tags from a JSON sample.
  • JSON to Zod SchemaGenerate a Zod schema (and inferred type) from a JSON sample.
  • JSON Schema GeneratorInfer a draft-07 JSON Schema from a sample document, with optional string format detection.
  • JSON Schema ValidatorValidate JSON data against a schema (type, properties, required, items, enum, min/max, pattern, anyOf/oneOf/allOf, local $ref).
  • JSONPath TesterRun JSONPath queries ($, ., .., [], [*], slices, unions, [?()] filters) against JSON.
  • JSON Pointer Tester (RFC 6901)Evaluate JSON Pointers (/a/0/b, URI fragments like #/a%20b) against a document. Handles ~0 and ~1 escapes and shows the escaped form.
  • JSON Patch Generator (RFC 6902 diff)Compare an original and a modified JSON document and produce the add / remove / replace operations that turn one into the other.
  • JSON Patch Applier (RFC 6902)Apply a JSON Patch (add, remove, replace, move, copy, test) to a document. The error names the failing operation.
  • JSON Flatten / UnflattenFlatten nested JSON to dotted keys (a.b[0].c) or rebuild the nested structure from flat keys.
  • JSON to GraphQL Query / SchemaBuild a GraphQL query selection set from a sample JSON response, or infer GraphQL SDL types from it.
  • JSON to SQL (CREATE TABLE + INSERT)Infer a table from a JSON array of objects: column types, NULLability, and escaped INSERT statements for PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQLite.
  • JSON to Java / Kotlin / Swift / Python / C# / Rust ModelsGenerate typed model classes from sample JSON: Java records, Kotlin data classes, Swift Codable, Python dataclasses, C# classes, Rust serde structs. Merges array items to find optional fields.
  • Avro Schema to JSON SchemaConvert an Avro schema (.avsc: records, enums, arrays, maps, unions, fixed, logical types, named references) to JSON Schema draft 2020-12.
  • JSON Schema to ZodTurn a JSON Schema (draft-07 / 2020-12 subset: types, formats, bounds, enum/const, anyOf/oneOf/allOf, $ref to $defs) into Zod source code.
  • Zod to JSON SchemaParse Zod source (z.object, string/number checks, enum, union, array, optional/nullable/default, const references) and emit JSON Schema. Static parser, no code is executed.
  • JSON Array Splitter / ChunkerSplit a JSON array into chunks of N items (or N chunks) and output them as an array of arrays or separate JSON documents.
  • JSON Size AnalyzerFind out why a JSON payload is big: raw / minified / pretty / gzip byte sizes, value-type counts, depth, and the heaviest paths and keys by serialized size.
  • JSON / CSV Grid EditorEdit tabular data in a spreadsheet-like grid: paste or open JSON (array of objects) or CSV, edit cells, add / delete rows and columns, rename headers, sort by a column, then copy or download as CSV or JSON. Numbers and booleans are kept as typed values in JSON output. Everything stays in your browser.
  • jq Playground (Online jq Filter Tester)Run jq filters on JSON in your browser: paths, pipes, select, map, group_by, sort_by, reduce, if/else, string interpolation, @csv/@tsv/@base64 and about 90 built-ins. A jq subset: no assignments, def or path functions.
  • JSON5 Validator & JSON5 / JSON ConverterParse JSON5 (comments, trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys, hex numbers) and convert to strict JSON, or write JSON as readable JSON5.
  • NDJSON / JSON Lines Viewer (Table, Sort, CSV)Read newline-delimited JSON as a table. Keys become columns (nested keys use dot paths), rows can be sorted, and bad lines are reported with their line number.
  • JSON to JavaScript Object Literal ConverterTurn JSON into a JavaScript object literal: unquoted keys, your choice of quotes, trailing commas and an optional const declaration.

CSV (11)

  • CSV to JSONParse CSV (RFC 4180 quotes, any delimiter) into JSON with optional type inference.
  • CSV ViewerView CSV as a sortable, filterable table. Open a file or paste text.
  • CSV to SQL INSERTGenerate INSERT statements (and optionally CREATE TABLE) from CSV.
  • CSV to Markdown TableTurn CSV into an aligned Markdown (GFM) table.
  • CSV to HTML TableGenerate an HTML table from CSV, with a live preview.
  • CSV Column ExtractorPick, reorder or drop CSV columns by header name or 1-based index (ranges like 2-4 work), optionally de-duplicate, and output CSV, one value per line or JSON.
  • CSV / TSV Transposer (Swap Rows and Columns)Transpose a table: rows become columns and columns become rows. Handles quoted fields and ragged rows, for CSV, TSV or semicolon data.
  • CSV Column Profiler (Types, Nulls, Unique, Min/Max)Profile each column of a CSV: inferred type, empty count, distinct values, min / max / mean for numbers, shortest and longest text, and most frequent values.
  • CSV to Chart (Bar, Line, Pie as SVG)Turn a small CSV into a bar, line or pie chart as a downloadable SVG with a data table for accessibility. First column is the label, other columns are series.
  • CSV Delimiter Converter (Comma, Semicolon, Tab, Pipe)Switch a CSV between comma, semicolon, tab and pipe delimiters. Quoted fields are parsed and re-quoted correctly, and the input delimiter can be detected.
  • CSV Deduplicator (Remove Duplicate Rows by Key Columns)Remove duplicate rows from a CSV by one or more key columns, keep the first or last match, ignore case or spaces, and list what was removed.

XML (8)

  • XML FormatterPretty-print XML with consistent indentation (mixed content is preserved).
  • XML MinifierStrip whitespace between elements and (optionally) comments.
  • XML ValidatorCheck that XML is well-formed using the browser parser.
  • XML to JSONConvert XML to JSON: attributes get a prefix, repeated elements become arrays, text goes to #text.
  • XPath TesterEvaluate XPath 1.0 expressions against XML using the browser engine.
  • XSD Schema Viewer (Element Tree)Paste an XML Schema (XSD) and see its elements, types, attributes, occurrence limits and restrictions as an indented tree.
  • XSLT Playground (Transform XML in Your Browser)Apply an XSLT 1.0 stylesheet to pasted XML and see the output. Uses the XSLT engine built into your browser, so nothing is uploaded.
  • XSD Validator (Check XML Against an XML Schema)Check an XML document against an XSD 1.0 schema in your browser. Reports element order, missing or extra elements, attributes, types, enumerations, patterns and ranges with the path of each problem.

YAML & TOML (7)

  • YAML to JSONConvert YAML to JSON. Supports maps, lists, flow style, | and > blocks, anchors/aliases/merge keys, multiple documents.
  • YAML FormatterRe-indent and normalise YAML (comments are not preserved; anchors are expanded).
  • TOML to JSONParse TOML (tables, arrays of tables, inline tables, dotted keys, dates) into JSON.
  • YAML to TOMLConvert YAML (maps, lists, anchors, multi-line strings) to TOML tables and arrays of tables. Null values are rejected, as TOML has none.
  • YAML Validator (Syntax, Duplicate Keys, Tabs)Check YAML for syntax and indentation errors with line numbers, plus a review list for tabs used as indentation and duplicate keys in the same mapping.
  • TOML to YAML Converter (Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml)Validate TOML and convert it to YAML. Tables, arrays of tables, inline tables and dotted keys are handled, and syntax errors name the line.
  • Java .properties to YAML Converter (Spring application.properties)Convert Java .properties files to nested YAML (dotted keys become maps, a[0] becomes lists), or turn YAML into .properties lines. Escapes and line continuations are handled.

Code Formatters (16)

  • HTML FormatterBeautify HTML with indentation; formats inline <style> and <script> too.
  • HTML MinifierRemove comments and unnecessary whitespace from HTML (keeps <pre>, minifies inline CSS/JS).
  • CSS FormatterBeautify CSS, including nested rules and @media blocks.
  • CSS MinifierStrip comments and whitespace from CSS without touching strings or url().
  • JavaScript FormatterBeautify JavaScript with sensible indentation and spacing (token based, no AST).
  • JavaScript MinifierStrip comments and whitespace safely (strings, regex and template literals are preserved; no renaming).
  • SQL FormatterUppercase keywords and lay out clauses, joins and subqueries on separate lines.
  • SQL MinifierStrip comments and extra whitespace from SQL, keeping strings intact.
  • Source Map Stack Trace Decoder (Minified Position Lookup)Paste a minified stack trace or line:column positions plus the .map file and get original file, line, column, name and source lines.
  • Code Syntax Highlighter (HTML With Inline Styles)Colour a code snippet and copy it as self-contained HTML with inline styles, in a light or dark theme, for blogs, emails and docs.
  • Big-O Complexity Cheatsheet (Sorting, Structures, Graphs)Time and space complexity of common sorting, search, data structure and graph algorithms, plus how many steps each growth class needs for your n.
  • Code Comment Stripper (JS, CSS, Python, SQL, HTML, Shell)Remove line and block comments from code while leaving strings alone. Optionally keep license comments and drop the blank lines left behind.
  • Lines of Code Counter (Code, Comment and Blank, Per Language)Count code, comment and blank lines. Paste one file, or several files each started by a line like "=== path/file.py" to get a per-language table.
  • Cyclomatic Complexity Estimator for JavaScript FunctionsEstimate McCabe cyclomatic complexity per function: 1 plus branches (if, loops, case, catch, &&, ||, ??, ternary). Flags functions above your limit.
  • String Literal Escaper (Java, C, C#, Python, Go, Rust, JSON, SQL, Bash)Turn raw text into a quoted string literal for Java, C, C#, Python, Go, Rust, JavaScript, JSON, PHP, SQL or Bash, or undo common backslash escapes.
  • TypeScript to JavaScript Converter (Strip Types, Enums, Parameter Properties)Remove TypeScript syntax and get plain modern JavaScript: annotations, interfaces, type aliases, generics, enums, as and satisfies, access modifiers, optional parameters, parameter properties. Unsupported syntax is rejected.

Code Generators (12)

  • cURL to CodeConvert a curl command to fetch, Node (http/https), Python requests or PHP cURL.
  • SVG to JSXConvert SVG markup to a React JSX component (class, kebab-case attributes, style objects).
  • HTML to JSXConvert HTML to JSX: className, htmlFor, style objects, self-closing tags, camelCased attributes.
  • Faker.js Mock Factory GeneratorTurn a sample JSON object into a @faker-js/faker factory function. Field names and value shapes pick the faker call (email, uuid, dates, urls, names...). Nested objects and arrays are supported.
  • Prisma Seed Script GeneratorRead a Prisma schema and write prisma/seed.ts using @faker-js/faker: models are seeded in foreign-key order, relations pick existing rows, enums and defaults are respected.
  • cURL to C# / Java / Axios / Guzzle / FaradayConvert a curl command (-X -H -d --data-urlencode --json -F -u -k -L) into C# HttpClient, Java 11 HttpClient, JavaScript axios, PHP Guzzle or Ruby Faraday. Python, fetch, Node and plain PHP live in the main cURL to Code tool; Go and Rust have their own tools. Multipart (-F) is supported for C#, Guzzle and Faraday; Java and axios convert it to a urlencoded body.
  • cURL to Vercel AI SDKTurn a curl call to an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions or Anthropic /messages endpoint into Vercel AI SDK generateText / streamText code (model, system, messages, temperature, max tokens). The API key is replaced by an environment variable.
  • cURL to Postman CollectionConvert one or more curl commands (one per blank-line separated block) into an importable Postman Collection v2.1 JSON with headers, query params, raw/urlencoded/form-data body and basic auth.
  • cURL to HARConvert a curl command to a HAR 1.2 request entry (method, URL, headers, query string, cookies, postData) that can be imported into HAR-based tools. No response is recorded.
  • fetch() to cURLConvert a JavaScript fetch(url, { method, headers, body }) call (as copied from DevTools or source) into a curl command. Understands JSON.stringify(...) bodies, string and object literals; it never executes your code.
  • Unit Test Stub Generator (Jest, Vitest, pytest from Function Signatures)Paste JavaScript, TypeScript or Python functions and get test stubs with edge-case inputs derived from parameter names, types and defaults, plus throw tests. A signature parser, not an AI: you still write the assertions.
  • JSDoc and Python Docstring Skeleton GeneratorPaste JavaScript, TypeScript or Python functions and get JSDoc or Google-style docstring skeletons with parameters, defaults, return and throws filled from the signature. A parser, not an AI.

Encoding (39)

  • Base64 EncodeEncode text (UTF-8 safe) to Base64 or URL-safe Base64.
  • Base64 DecodeDecode Base64 / URL-safe Base64 to UTF-8 text.
  • Base64 Image ViewerPreview and download an image from a data URI or raw Base64.
  • URL EncodePercent-encode text for URLs.
  • URL DecodeDecode percent-encoded text.
  • HTML Entities Encode / DecodeEscape or unescape HTML entities (named, decimal and hex).
  • Hex ⇄ TextConvert text to hexadecimal bytes (UTF-8) and back.
  • Binary ⇄ TextConvert text to 8-bit binary (UTF-8) and back.
  • Morse Code TranslatorTranslate text to Morse code and back (letters separated by space, words by " / ").
  • Number Base ConverterConvert arbitrarily large integers between bases 2-36, with two's complement.
  • Unicode Escape / UnescapeConvert text to \uXXXX / \u{X} escapes and back (also \xNN, U+XXXX).
  • Punycode / IDN ConverterConvert internationalized domain names to xn-- Punycode and back.
  • UTF-8 Bytes ViewerShow code points with their UTF-8 and UTF-16 byte sequences.
  • ROT13 / Caesar CipherShift letters by N (ROT13 by default) or apply ROT47.
  • Base32 Encode / DecodeRFC 4648 Base32 (or extended-hex alphabet) for UTF-8 text.
  • ASCII TableASCII reference: decimal, hex, octal, binary, character. Filter by anything.
  • Unicode Character InspectorCode point, category, script, encodings and escapes for each character.
  • Gzip Compress (Base64)Compress text with gzip/deflate and output Base64.
  • Gzip Decompress (Base64)Decode Base64 and decompress gzip/deflate data to text.
  • String Length & Byte SizeCharacters, code points, graphemes, words, lines and byte sizes in UTF-8/16/32.
  • Quoted-Printable Encoder / DecoderMIME quoted-printable (RFC 2045): encode UTF-8 text with 76-column soft line breaks, or decode it back.
  • Base64URL Encoder / DecoderURL-safe Base64 (RFC 4648 section 5): - and _ instead of + and /, no padding. Decoder accepts standard Base64 too.
  • Morse Code Audio GeneratorTurn text into Morse code and a playable, downloadable WAV beep track (PARIS timing, adjustable speed and pitch).
  • Base58 Encoder / DecoderBitcoin-alphabet Base58 (no checksum) for text or hex bytes. Used by Solana addresses, IPFS CIDv0 and more.
  • Crockford Base32 Encoder / DecoderCrockford Base32 (no I, L, O, U; case-insensitive; O and I decode as 0 and 1) for text or hex bytes, as used by ULIDs.
  • ROT47 Encoder / DecoderROT47 rotates all printable ASCII (33-126) by 47 positions. Applying it twice returns the original.
  • Hex Dump ViewerClassic hexdump -C style view (offset, hex bytes, ASCII) of UTF-8 text or pasted hex bytes.
  • IEEE 754 Float / Hex ConverterShow a number as 32-bit and 64-bit IEEE 754 hex and bits (sign, exponent, mantissa), or decode a hex pattern to a float.
  • BCD (Binary-Coded Decimal) ConverterConvert decimal numbers to packed/unpacked BCD nibbles and back.
  • Hex ⇄ Base64 ConverterConvert raw bytes between hexadecimal and Base64 (or Base64URL) directly, without going through text. Accepts 0x prefixes, spaces and colons in hex.
  • Base85 Converter: Ascii85 and Z85 Encode and DecodeEncode text or hex bytes to Ascii85 (PostScript, PDF) or Z85 (ZeroMQ), and decode both back, with optional <~ ~> delimiters.
  • UUencode Encoder and Decoder (begin / end Blocks)Encode text or bytes to classic uuencoded blocks with begin and end lines, or decode a uuencoded block back to text, hex or a file download.
  • MIME Encoded-Word Decoder (=?UTF-8?B?...?= Email Headers)Decode =?charset?B?...?= and =?charset?Q?...?= words in email Subject or From headers (RFC 2047), or encode non-ASCII header text.
  • Protobuf Raw Decoder (Wire Format Without a Schema)Paste protobuf bytes as hex or Base64 and see each field number, wire type and a best-guess reading: varint, fixed, string, nested message or bytes.
  • Bencode Decoder and .torrent ViewerDecode bencoded data from pasted text or a .torrent file into a readable tree, with tracker, files, size and info hash for torrents.
  • Data URI Inspector: Type, Size and Decoded PreviewParse a data: URI and see its MIME type, charset, encoding, decoded size, overhead and a type check against the real bytes, with an image preview.
  • File to Base64 Data URI Converter (Any File Type)Turn any file into a data: URI, raw Base64, a CSS url() value or an HTML tag. The file stays in your browser.
  • Base64 to File Downloader (Any File Type)Decode a Base64, Base64URL or data: URI string and download the bytes as a file, with the file type detected from the content.
  • Emoji and Symbol Code Converter: U+ Code Points, HTML Entities, CSS and JS EscapesPaste emojis or symbols (or U+ codes) and get the code points, HTML hex and decimal entities, CSS escape, JavaScript escape, UTF-8 bytes and UTF-16 units for each character.

Hashing & JWT (16)

  • Hash GeneratorMD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 of your text, all at once.
  • File HashMD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 of a file, computed locally.
  • Hash CompareCompare two hashes (case/whitespace-insensitive) and guess the algorithm from length.
  • HMAC GeneratorHMAC with MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 or SHA-512; hex and Base64 output.
  • JWT DecoderDecode a JWT header and payload with human-readable exp/iat/nbf. Does not verify the signature.
  • JWT Encoder / SignerCreate and sign a JWT with HS256, HS384 or HS512.
  • JWT Verifier (HS256/384/512)Verify a JWT signature with a shared secret and check exp/nbf.
  • CRC32 & Adler-32 ChecksumCRC-32 (IEEE) and Adler-32 checksums of your text (UTF-8).
  • X.509 Certificate ViewerPaste a PEM certificate: subject, issuer, validity, SANs, key info and fingerprints.
  • JWT Expiry CalculatorCheck exp / nbf / iat of one or more JWTs against now (or a time you choose) with optional clock-skew leeway: remaining lifetime, total lifetime, and warnings. The signature is not verified.
  • SHA-3 / Keccak / SHAKE Hash GeneratorSHA3-224/256/384/512, Keccak-256 and Keccak-512 (the pre-standard padding used by Ethereum), and the SHAKE128 / SHAKE256 extendable-output functions with a chosen output length. Hand-written Keccak-f[1600]; the browser Web Crypto API has no SHA-3, so this is pure JavaScript (fine for text, slow for megabytes).
  • Webhook Signature Verifier (HMAC)Verify a webhook's HMAC signature locally: paste the raw request body, the signature header(s) and your signing secret, choose the provider (GitHub, Stripe, Slack, Shopify, Standard Webhooks/Svix or generic HMAC) and see the expected signature, a constant-time comparison and, where relevant, timestamp tolerance. The body must be the exact raw bytes received (no re-serialised JSON).
  • API Key Generator (prefixed, with checksum & hash)Generate production-style API keys: a recognisable prefix (sk_live_, pk_test_, ghp_ style), cryptographically random body from crypto.getRandomValues (no modulo bias), optional CRC-32 checksum suffix like GitHub tokens (lets scanners and servers reject typos without a database lookup), and the SHA-256 hash to store instead of the key.
  • JWT Signature Validator (RS / PS / ES / EdDSA / HS)Verify a JWT signature against a public key (PEM SPKI, PKCS#1, X.509 certificate), a JWK or a JWKS (matched by kid), or an HMAC secret. Supports RS256/384/512, PS256/384/512, ES256/384/512, EdDSA (Ed25519) and HS256/384/512, decodes header and payload and checks exp / nbf / iat. Blocks the classic "HS256 signed with the public key" algorithm-confusion trick and flags alg "none".
  • Android Keystore / Certificate Fingerprints (SHA-1, SHA-256, MD5)Compute the MD5 / SHA-1 / SHA-256 certificate fingerprints that Firebase, Google Sign-In, Play App Signing and assetlinks.json ask for, from a PEM / base64 certificate (keytool -exportcert -rfc) or by opening a JKS / .keystore file directly (certificates in a JKS are not encrypted, so no password is needed). PKCS12 (.p12/.pfx) keystores are password-encrypted and are not supported: use keytool -list -v.
  • JWT Sign & Verify (RS256, PS256, ES256 and more)Sign a JWT with an RSA or ECDSA private key, verify one with a public key, or generate a key pair. WebCrypto in your browser; keys never leave the page.

  • Moon Phase Calculator: Phase, Illumination and Next Full MoonFind the moon phase, how much of the disc is lit and the next new and full moons for a date, plus a table for the whole month.
  • Public Holidays Lookup (10 Countries, Rule-Based, No Lookup Sent)List national public holidays for Belgium, France, Germany, the Netherlands, England and Wales, Spain, Italy, Austria, Luxembourg or the US federal calendar, computed from the holiday rules in your browser. Years 2015 to 2060.

Network & HTTP (58)

  • HTTP Status CodesSearchable reference of HTTP status codes and what they mean.

  • MAC Address GeneratorGenerate random MAC addresses (cryptographically random) as unicast/multicast, globally- or locally-administered, optionally with your own OUI prefix, in colon, dash, Cisco-dot or plain format.

Supports A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT (auto-split at 255 bytes), NS, SRV, CAA, PTR. Not a resolver: nothing is looked up or published.
  • HTTP Cache-Control TesterPaste response headers and see whether a browser or shared cache (CDN) may store the response, how long it stays fresh, and when it must revalidate. Follows RFC 9111 rules for max-age, s-maxage, Expires and heuristic freshness.
  • DNS SOA & DNSSEC Record InspectorDecode pasted SOA, DNSKEY, DS/CDS, RRSIG and NSEC3PARAM records: timers vs RFC 1912 guidance, key tags, KSK/ZSK roles, algorithms, signature validity windows, and whether a DS digest really matches the DNSKEY (SHA-1/256/384 computed locally).
  • IP Supernetting (CIDR Aggregation)Aggregate IPv4/IPv6 addresses, CIDR blocks and ranges (a-b) into the smallest set of CIDR prefixes, plus the single smallest supernet that covers everything and how much address space it wastes.

  • TLS Handshake SimulatorStep through TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 handshakes (full, resumption, mutual TLS, 0-RTT): messages, what each carries, round trips, and time before the first request byte at your RTT. An explanatory model, not a packet capture.
  • HTTP/2 & HTTP/3 Frame InspectorDecode hex dumps of HTTP/2 frames (with the client preface, SETTINGS, HEADERS with HPACK, DATA, GOAWAY ...) or HTTP/3 frames (varint type/length, SETTINGS). HPACK Huffman-coded strings are shown as hex and QPACK blocks are not decoded.

The tool never queries DNS: resolve each include yourself (dig +short TXT domain).
  • CORS Preflight InspectorDescribe the browser request (method, Origin, headers) and paste the server's response headers: see whether a preflight is needed, what the OPTIONS request would contain, and exactly why the response would be accepted or blocked.
  • API Rate Limit & Cost CalculatorGiven a rate limit and price plan, calculate how long a bulk job takes, how many API keys you need to hit a deadline, the monthly ceiling and the cost including plan fee, included quota and overage.

Regex (11)

  • Regex TesterTest a JavaScript regex: matches with indexes, capture groups, named groups and replace preview.
  • Regex Cheat SheetJavaScript regular expression syntax quick reference.
  • Regex Benchmark & ReDoS SimulatorTime a JavaScript regex against your text: ops/second, plus a scaling test (input repeated 1x-16x) that reveals polynomial or exponential backtracking. A static check flags nested quantifiers. A catastrophic pattern can freeze the tab: start with short input.
  • Regex Explainer (Plain English)Paste a JavaScript regular expression and get a line-by-line explanation of every token, group, lookaround, quantifier and flag.

  • Regex Railroad Diagram GeneratorDraw a JavaScript regular expression as a railroad (syntax) diagram: alternatives, optional parts, loops, groups and lookarounds. SVG, drawn in your browser.
  • Regex Test Cases Runner (Should Match / Should Not Match)Run one JavaScript regex against a list of strings that must match and a list that must not. Each line gets pass or fail, with a summary.
  • ReDoS Checker: Static Scan for Catastrophic BacktrackingScan a JavaScript regex for patterns that can backtrack catastrophically: nested quantifiers, overlapping alternatives, adjacent overlapping repeats. A review aid, not a proof.
  • PCRE Regex Tester (PCRE2 Syntax, Lookbehind, Recursion)Test a PCRE2-style pattern with a hand-written backtracking engine: named groups, lookahead and lookbehind, atomic and possessive quantifiers, backreferences, conditionals, recursion and \K. Offline.
  • Python re Regex Tester (Python 3.12 Syntax, finditer and sub)Test a pattern with Python re semantics without Python: (?P<name>), (?P=name), lookbehind that must be fixed width, atomic groups, possessive quantifiers, flags, finditer and re.sub templates.
