  • Design Tokens Converter (W3C JSON to CSS, SCSS, Tailwind, JS)Convert design tokens in the W3C Design Tokens format ($value, $type, groups, {aliases}) into CSS custom properties, SCSS variables, a Tailwind v4 @theme block or a JavaScript object.
  • CSS Spring Easing Generator (linear() Function)Turn spring physics (mass, stiffness, damping) into a CSS linear() easing and a matching transition duration, with the damping ratio and overshoot shown.
  • CSS Scroll-Driven Animation GeneratorGenerate CSS for scroll progress bars, reveal-on-scroll and parallax using animation-timeline: scroll() and view(), with a fallback for browsers without support.
  • CSS View Transitions GeneratorGenerate CSS and JavaScript for same-document view transitions: cross-fade, slide or morph of named elements, with reduced-motion handling.
  • CSS Container Query GeneratorGenerate CSS container queries for a card or component: name the container, set breakpoints on its width, and get layout rules with container query units and a media-query fallback.
  • CSS Transform Generator: Rotate, Scale, Skew, Translate and 3DCombine translate, rotate (2D and 3D), scale, skew, perspective and transform-origin with sliders-as-numbers and copy the transform declaration. Identity values are left out.
  • Hex Colour to CSS Filter (Recolour a Black Icon)Search for an invert, sepia, saturate, hue-rotate, brightness and contrast chain that turns a black image or icon into a target hex colour, and show how close the result is.
  • Modular Type Scale Generator (Ratio to CSS Variables)Build a modular font-size scale from a base size and ratio such as 1.25 or 1.618, preview heading and body sizes, and copy rem custom properties.
  • CSS @keyframes Builder from Keyframe LinesWrite one line per keyframe (percent, then declarations) and get a complete @keyframes block plus the animation shorthand, with a live preview of a moving box.
  • CSS Multi-Column Layout Generator (columns, gap, rule)Set column-count, column-width, column-gap and column-rule, preview sample text flowing into columns, and copy the CSS including break-inside and column-span helpers.
  • Custom Checkbox and Toggle Switch CSS Generator (Accessible)Style a checkbox or switch with pure CSS on top of a real input element: size, colours, radius, transition, focus ring and reduced-motion handling. Copy the HTML and CSS.
  • CSS Button Style Generator with Hover, Active and Focus StatesDesign a button with padding, colours, border, radius, shadow and font, set separate hover and active colours, preview it live and copy the CSS.
  • CSS Custom Property Theme Builder with Dark Mode OverridesTurn lines of "name: light value | dark value" into a :root theme with a prefers-color-scheme dark block and optional data-theme override, with a live sample card.
  • Tailwind Classes to Plain CSS Rules (with hover and responsive variants)Expand a list of Tailwind v4 utility classes into plain CSS rules, including colour utilities, hover and focus states, md: breakpoints and dark mode. Unknown classes are listed.
  • Column Grid Planner: Columns, Gutters and Margins with CSSWork out column widths and positions for a design grid and copy the CSS.

Images (55)

  • Image ResizerResize by pixels or percent, keep aspect ratio, choose output format. Batch supported.
  • Image CompressorRe-encode as JPEG or WebP at a chosen quality and see the size savings. Batch supported.
  • Image Format ConverterConvert images to PNG, JPEG or WebP (formats browsers can encode).
  • Image CropperCrop by numeric rectangle, or center-crop to an aspect ratio.
  • Image Rotate & FlipRotate by any angle (canvas expands to fit) and flip horizontally or vertically.
  • Image FiltersGrayscale, sepia, brightness, contrast, blur, invert, saturation and hue (uses canvas filters; not in older Safari).
  • Image WatermarkAdd a text watermark (single or tiled) with opacity, size and rotation.
  • Image to Base64Encode images as data URIs, ready for <img>, CSS or raw Base64.
  • Image Collage MakerArrange several images into a grid collage.
  • Placeholder Image GeneratorMake a WxH placeholder image with custom colors and text, as PNG or SVG.
  • Favicon GeneratorFrom one image: favicon.ico, 16/32/48/180/192/512 PNGs, an HTML snippet and site.webmanifest.
  • App Icon GeneratorGenerate iOS and Android app icon PNG sizes from one square-ish image.
  • Image to ASCII ArtConvert an image to ASCII text art.
  • Image InfoDimensions, type, size, aspect ratio, transparency and dominant colors of images.
  • OpenGraph Banner GeneratorDraw a 1200x630 social share image (title, subtitle, brand, gradient background) on a canvas and download it as PNG.
  • ICO to PNG Converter (All Icon Sizes)Open a .ico (or .cur) file and save every size inside it as a PNG with transparency. Reads PNG-compressed and classic bitmap icons (1, 4, 8, 16, 24 and 32 bit).
  • Background Remover for Plain Backgrounds (No AI)Make a solid or near-solid background transparent by flood-filling from the edges with an adjustable tolerance. Good for logos, product shots on white and screenshots. Not a photo cut-out tool.
  • Image Grid Splitter (Instagram Grid, Tiles)Cut an image into a grid of equal tiles (3x1 carousel, 3x3 Instagram grid, any rows and columns) and download them in posting order, with optional gaps and square cropping.
  • Code to Image: Code Screenshot Maker (PNG)Turn a code snippet into a shareable PNG with syntax colours, window controls, line numbers and a gradient background. Supports JavaScript, Python, JSON, HTML, SQL, Go, Rust and shell.
  • Quote Image Maker: Text on a Background (PNG)Make a quote card as a PNG: wrap text on a colour or gradient background with an author line, in square, landscape (1200x630) or story (1080x1920) sizes. Auto-fits the text.
  • Meme Generator: Add Top and Bottom Text to an ImagePut classic white outlined meme text at the top and bottom of any image, auto-sized to fit, and save the result as a PNG. The picture never leaves your device.
  • QR Code Reader: Decode a QR Image in Your BrowserRead a QR code from a picture or screenshot: finds the code, corrects errors with Reed-Solomon and shows the text, version, error-correction level and mask. Hand-written decoder, nothing is uploaded.
  • GeoTIFF Viewer: Georeferencing, Tags and Raster PreviewOpen a GeoTIFF (or any TIFF / BigTIFF) in your browser: CRS (EPSG), pixel size, bounding box, tags, NoData, band statistics and a PNG preview of the raster. LZW, Deflate and PackBits supported. Hand-written reader; nothing is uploaded.
  • PSD Viewer: Layers, Composite and Flatten (Photoshop File)Open a Photoshop .psd in your browser: list layers (names, bounds, blend modes, opacity, groups), see the stored composite, flatten the pixel layers with opacity, masks and common blend modes, or export a single layer as PNG. RGB and grayscale, 8 and 16 bit.
  • Image to SVG Tracer (Posterise and Vectorise)Turn a PNG, JPG or WebP into a layered SVG: reduce to a few colours, remove specks, trace the outlines with holes and smooth them into curves. Good for logos, icons and flat artwork, not for photos. Runs in your browser.
  • GPS Location Stripper for JPEG (Keep Other Metadata)Delete only the GPS location tags from JPEG photos and keep camera, lens, exposure and date metadata. The image data is not re-encoded.
  • Photo GPS Coordinates Export (CSV, GeoJSON, KML, Map Links)Read the GPS position, altitude and date from many geotagged JPEGs and list them as a table, CSV, GeoJSON or KML, with an OpenStreetMap link per photo. Nothing is loaded from a map server.
  • Lossless JPEG Rotator (Change EXIF Orientation, No Re-encoding)Fix sideways phone photos by changing the EXIF orientation tag only. The compressed image data is untouched, so there is no quality loss.
  • Photo Date Fixer (Shift EXIF Capture Time in Batch)Shift the capture time of JPEG photos by an offset such as +6h, or set the first photo to a date and move the rest by the same amount, so a camera with a wrong clock or time zone sorts correctly.
  • IPTC Caption, Keywords and Copyright Editor for JPEG (Batch)Read and write the IPTC caption, keywords, creator and copyright notice in JPEG files, one set of fields for many photos, with an optional license link in XMP. Leave all fields empty to just read what is there.
  • ICC Colour Profile Inspector for JPEG, PNG and WebPSee whether an image carries an embedded ICC colour profile and read its name, colour space, version, white point, primaries and curves, with a check against sRGB.
  • PNG to JPG Converter with Background ColourConvert PNG, WebP or other images to JPEG and choose the colour that fills transparent areas, since JPEG has no transparency. Set the quality and convert many files at once.
  • Batch Image Optimizer (Compress Many Images to a ZIP)Drop in many photos, pick one quality and a maximum width, and download the compressed JPEG or WebP versions in one ZIP. Files that would get bigger can keep the original.
  • Thumbnail Batch Generator (Uniform Square Thumbnails in a ZIP)Make same-size thumbnails from many images by centre-cropping or padding them to a square or any fixed size, then download them together in a ZIP.
  • Image Border and Frame Adder (Solid, Rounded, Polaroid)Add a solid border, rounded corners or a polaroid-style frame with a thick bottom edge to a picture and download the framed image.
  • Image Format Comparator (JPEG, WebP, AVIF and PNG Side by Side)Encode one image as JPEG, WebP, AVIF and PNG at the quality you choose and compare file size and PSNR, with the results shown next to each other. AVIF shows only if your browser can encode it.
  • Image Histogram Viewer (RGB and Luminance, Clipping Check)Draw the red, green, blue and luminance histograms of a photo and see how many pixels are crushed to black or blown to white, to judge exposure.
  • Error Level Analysis (ELA) for JPEG PhotosRecompress a JPEG at a fixed quality and show the amplified difference, so areas that were edited or pasted in may stand out. A hint for review, not proof of tampering.
  • Screenshot Device Framer (Phone, Tablet, Laptop, Browser Mockup)Place a screenshot inside a generic phone, tablet, laptop or browser window frame on a plain or transparent background and download it as a PNG.
  • Before and After Image Slider Maker (Embeddable HTML)Turn two images into a before and after comparison slider you can paste into a page. The code is one small block with a keyboard-operable range input and the images embedded as data URIs.
  • Image Hash Comparator (Perceptual pHash, dHash and aHash)Compute perceptual hashes for two or more images and compare them by Hamming distance to find near-duplicates, resized copies and re-compressed versions.
  • Duplicate Photo Finder (Group Visually Similar Photos)Select a folder full of photos (select all files in the dialog) and group the ones that look alike, such as resized or re-saved copies, with a suggestion of which one to keep.
  • BlurHash Generator (Compact Image Placeholder String)Compute a BlurHash for an image, a short string that decodes to a blurred placeholder while the real picture loads, and preview the blurred result for the component count you choose.
  • PNG Quantizer (Shrink PNG Files with a Reduced Colour Palette)Reduce a PNG to 256, 64 or fewer colours with median-cut and optional dithering, and save a smaller indexed PNG. Transparency is kept.
  • GIF Frame Extractor (Split an Animated GIF into PNG Frames)Decode every frame of an animated GIF, view them as numbered thumbnails with their delays, and download chosen frames as PNG files or all of them in a ZIP.
  • Sprite Sheet Packer (PNG Atlas with JSON and CSS Map)Pack many images into one sprite sheet PNG and get a JSON map of each sprite name, position and size, plus ready CSS classes for use on a page.
  • Perspective Corrector (Straighten a Photo of a Page or Building)Mark the four corners of a document, whiteboard or facade in a photo and warp it into a flat rectangle. Drag the corners or type their positions.
  • Image Mask Painter (Paint Transparency, Export PNG)Brush over parts of a picture to make them transparent, or restore them, then save a PNG. Works with a mouse, touch or the keyboard, and has rectangle controls and undo.
  • Noise Texture Generator: Tileable Grain PNGMake a transparent grain or noise tile to overlay on gradients and flat colours.
  • Simple Logo Maker: Shape, Initials and Name to SVG and PNGCombine a geometric shape and your brand name into a simple logo.
  • Social Media Banner Maker with Safe-Area GuidesMake a header image at a chosen size with text, a colour or photo background and a safe-area guide.
  • Composition Guides Overlay: Rule of Thirds and Golden Spiral on a PhotoDraw thirds, phi grid, diagonals and a golden spiral over an image and save the result.
  • Emoji Sticker Composer: Combine Two Emoji into a Transparent PNGPlace two emoji together as one sticker image.
  • Document Scanner: Straighten, Clean Up and Save Photos of Pages as PDFLoad photos of paper pages, find the page corners automatically or type them in, straighten the perspective, flatten shadows to black and white or grey, and save a multi-page PDF. All local.
  • Whiteboard: Pan, Zoom and Draw with Mouse, Touch or KeyboardA sketch canvas you can pan and zoom without limits. Pen, line, rectangle, ellipse, text and eraser, undo and redo, with full keyboard drawing. Exports SVG or PNG; nothing leaves the page.

SVG (7)

  • SVG OptimizerStrip comments, metadata and editor cruft, drop empty groups and unused ids, shorten numbers and collapse whitespace.
  • SVG to PNG ConverterRasterize SVG code to PNG, JPEG or WebP at any scale with optional background.
  • SVG Preview EditorEdit SVG code and see it rendered live, with syntax validation.
  • SVG Pattern GeneratorSeamless SVG background patterns (dots, grid, lines, waves, checker...) as SVG and CSS.
  • SVG Path EditorParse an SVG path, translate/scale it, convert absolute/relative, round numbers, and list its points with a preview.
  • SVG Wavy Divider GeneratorGenerate a layered, seeded SVG wave divider (smooth curves) for section transitions. Choose layers, amplitude, number of waves, color, flip; copy the SVG or an inline CSS background.
  • SVG Icon Recolorer: Change Fill and Stroke Colors in BulkRecolour many SVG icons at once and download them as a ZIP.

Calculators – Finance (79)

  • Percentage CalculatorX% of Y, X is what % of Y, and change from X to Y.
  • Percent Change CalculatorPercentage increase or decrease between two values.
  • Discount CalculatorSale price after one or two discounts, plus optional tax.
  • Compound Interest CalculatorGrowth with regular contributions, any compounding frequency, yearly table.
  • Loan CalculatorMonthly payment, total interest and the first amortization rows.
  • EMI CalculatorEquated monthly installment for a loan.
  • SIP CalculatorFuture value of a monthly systematic investment plan.
  • ROI CalculatorReturn on investment and annualized return.
  • Markup & Margin CalculatorConvert between cost, markup % and margin %.
  • Profit Margin CalculatorGross profit, margin and markup from revenue and cost.
  • Break-Even CalculatorUnits and revenue needed to cover fixed costs.
  • Salary ↔ Hourly ConverterConvert between hourly, weekly, monthly and annual pay.
  • Tip CalculatorTip, total and per-person split.
  • VAT CalculatorAdd VAT to a net price or remove it from a gross price.
  • Retirement EstimatorProjected nest egg and sustainable income (4% rule).
  • Savings Goal CalculatorMonthly saving needed to reach a target.
  • Inflation CalculatorFuture cost and lost purchasing power at a constant rate.
  • Simple Interest CalculatorInterest = P × r × t.
  • Electricity Cost Calculator (Appliance Running Cost)Calculate what an appliance costs to run per day, month and year from its wattage, hours of use and your price per kWh, plus the CO2 estimate. Standby power included.
  • Australian Income Tax Estimator (Resident, Foreign Resident, Working Holiday)Estimate Australian income tax and Medicare levy for 2024-25, 2025-26 and 2026-27 from taxable income, with bracket breakdown, take-home pay, marginal rate and superannuation guarantee. Rates are built in and shown so you can check them.
  • Work From Home Deduction Calculator (Fixed Rate Method, Australia)Work out the Australian work-from-home deduction with the ATO fixed rate per hour method: hours per week, weeks worked, rate, value at your marginal tax rate and what it already covers. Rate is editable.
  • GST and BAS Worksheet Calculator (Australia, 10%)Add up sales and purchases with GST included, excluded or GST-free and get the BAS figures: G1 total sales, 1A GST on sales, 1B GST on purchases, G11 and the net amount to pay or refund. Rate is editable.
  • Capital Gains Calculator for Crypto and Shares (FIFO, LIFO, HIFO, 12-Month Discount)Paste buys and sells and get the capital gain or loss per disposal with FIFO, LIFO or highest-cost matching, holding period and the optional 12-month discount used in Australia. Rules are options, so it fits other countries.
  • Stacked Discount Calculator (Percent and Fixed Amounts in Order)Apply several discounts one after another, percent or fixed amount, and see each step, the total saved and the real combined percentage.
  • Break-Even Selling Price Calculator (Product, Shipping, Fees, Ads)Find the lowest price that covers product cost, packaging, shipping, platform fees and ad spend, with an optional target profit per order.
  • Amazon FBA Profit Calculator (Your Own Referral and Fulfilment Fees)Net profit, margin and ROI per unit from price, product cost and the referral and fulfilment fees you copy from Amazon. No fee table is built in.
  • Etsy Fee Calculator (Listing, Transaction and Payment Fees With Your Rates)Net earnings per sale from item price, shipping charged and the listing, transaction and payment rates you enter. Rate defaults are examples to check.
  • eBay Fee and Profit Calculator (Your Final Value Fee Rate)Estimate final value fee, per-order fee, promoted listing cost and profit on an eBay sale using the rates you enter. Defaults are examples to check.
  • Shopify Payment Fee Calculator (Compare Plans With Your Card Rates)Compare card processing fees across three plans for one order value or a month of orders, using the rates you enter. Defaults are examples to check.
  • Payment Fee Gross-Up Calculator (Charge So You Net a Target Amount)Work out the fee on a payment, or the amount to charge so that you receive a set net after a percentage plus fixed processing fee.
  • Dropshipping Profit Calculator (Supplier, Shipping, Fees, Ads, Refunds)Profit per order after supplier cost, shipping, payment fees, ad cost and refunds, plus the maximum ad cost per order and break-even ROAS.
  • Average Order Value (AOV) Calculator With Period ComparisonAverage order value and units per order from revenue and order count, with a change against a previous period.
  • Bundle Pricing Calculator (Discount Against Item Margins)Compare a bundle price with selling items one by one, see the margin you keep, and the biggest discount that still meets a target margin.
  • Startup Runway Calculator (Cash, Burn, Revenue Growth)Months of cash left from balance, expenses and revenue, optionally with monthly growth rates, and the month the cash runs out.
  • Burn Rate Calculator (Gross and Net Monthly Burn)Gross and net monthly burn from expenses and revenue, or from cash at the start and end of a period, with runway.
  • Startup Break-Even Analysis With Margin of Safety and Profit TargetBreak-even units and revenue from fixed costs, price and variable cost, plus units needed for a target profit and the margin of safety at your expected sales.
  • Equity Dilution Calculator Across Funding RoundsFollow founder ownership through several rounds from investment, pre-money valuation and option pool top-ups, and see the value of your stake.
  • Cap Table Simulator With Option Pool and New RoundEnter holders and shares, add a priced round with a pre-money valuation and optional pool top-up, and get the table before and after with price per share.
  • SAFE Conversion Calculator (Valuation Cap and Discount)Shares and ownership a SAFE converts into at a priced round, using the lower of the cap price and the discounted round price. Covers one SAFE only.
  • Pre-Money and Post-Money Valuation CalculatorFill in any two of pre-money valuation, investment and post-money valuation (leave the third at 0) and get the third plus the investor share.
  • MRR and ARR Calculator With Net New MRRMonthly and annual recurring revenue from plan prices and subscriber counts, plus new, expansion, contraction and churned MRR to get net new MRR and growth.
  • Churn Rate Calculator (Customer, Revenue, Net Revenue Retention)Customer churn, gross and net revenue churn, retention, annualised churn and expected lifetime from start-of-period figures.
  • SaaS Metrics Calculator (ARPU, LTV, CAC, Payback, LTV to CAC)Combine MRR, churn, gross margin and acquisition spend into ARPU, customer lifetime value, CAC, CAC payback and the LTV to CAC ratio.
  • Rule of 40 Calculator for SaaS Growth and ProfitAdd yearly revenue growth and a profit margin (EBITDA, operating or free cash flow) to see whether the total reaches the Rule of 40 benchmark.
  • Unit Economics Calculator (Contribution Margin per Order or Customer)Contribution per unit from revenue and a list of variable costs, plus payback of acquisition cost if you add it.
  • Pricing Tier Planner (Good-Better-Best Revenue and Margin)Compare plans by price, expected customers and cost per customer: revenue, margin, mix and blended revenue per customer.
  • Employee Total Cost Calculator (Salary, Employer Charges, Benefits, Overhead)Total yearly cost of an employee from gross salary and the employer tax rate, benefits, equipment and overhead you enter, with monthly and hourly cost.
  • Freelance Hourly Rate Calculator From Income TargetThe hourly rate you need to reach a take-home target after business costs, your own tax rate and realistic billable hours.
  • Contractor Day Rate to Annual Salary ConverterTurn a day rate and days worked into yearly income, hourly rate and an employee-equivalent salary after a benefits uplift you choose.
  • Mortgage Calculator with Full Amortization Schedule and OverpaymentsMonthly payment from price, deposit, rate and term, with a month-by-month schedule. Add a monthly or one-off overpayment to see interest saved and time cut.
  • Mortgage Affordability Calculator (Income, Debts and Debt-to-Income Limit)Estimate the largest loan and property price from gross income, monthly debts, deposit, rate and a debt-to-income limit you set.
  • Car Finance Calculator with Deposit and Balloon PaymentMonthly instalment and total cost of a car loan with a deposit and an optional final balloon payment.
  • Credit Card Payoff Calculator (Months to Zero, Interest, Payment Needed)Months to clear a card at a fixed monthly payment and the total interest, or the payment needed to clear it in a set number of months.
  • Debt Snowball vs Avalanche PlannerCompare paying the smallest balance first with the highest rate first for several debts. Shows months to debt-free, total interest and payoff order.
  • Emergency Fund Calculator (Months of Expenses)Target emergency fund from essential monthly costs and the number of months to cover, with the gap and the time to close it.
  • FIRE Number Calculator (Target Portfolio and Years to Reach It)Portfolio needed for financial independence from annual spending and a withdrawal rate, plus years to get there from your savings and expected return.
  • Euro Area Inflation Calculator (HICP 1996-2025)Adjust an amount between two years with the euro area HICP annual average index bundled in the page. Shows the equivalent value and average yearly inflation.
  • Purchasing Power Calculator (Year-by-Year Table)Table of what a sum will buy in today's terms after each year of inflation, with the cost of living adjustment you would need to stand still.
  • Budget Planner (50/30/20 Rule) with Actual Spending CheckSplit take-home pay into needs, wants and savings, then paste your real spending to see which category is over or under its share.
  • Net Worth Calculator (Assets Minus Liabilities)Total assets and liabilities from a pasted list and get net worth, the debt-to-asset ratio and the largest items.
  • Dividend Yield Calculator (Yield and Annual Income)Dividend yield from share price and annual dividend, plus yearly and monthly income for the shares you hold and the yield on your cost.
  • Dollar-Cost Averaging CalculatorSimulate investing a fixed amount each period at a list of prices: shares bought, average cost per share, current value and gain or loss.
  • Stock Profit Calculator (Gain or Loss After Fees)Net profit or loss on a trade including broker commissions, as an amount, as a percentage of what you invested, and the break-even sell price.
  • Pay Raise Calculator (New Salary and Increase)New salary and the increase per year, month, week and hour after a percentage or fixed raise.
  • APR to APY Converter (Nominal to Effective Annual Rate)Convert a nominal annual rate to the effective annual yield for any compounding frequency, or work backwards from APY to the nominal rate.
  • Rent vs Buy Calculator (Wealth After N Years)Compare the net wealth of renting and investing against buying a home, with mortgage, upkeep, price growth, rent growth and selling costs.
  • Lease vs Buy Car CalculatorTotal cost of leasing against buying a car over the same period, using lease payments and fees, loan terms and expected resale value.
  • Bill Splitter (Uneven Shares, Tax and Tip)Split a bill among people with items each person ordered, a shared amount split by weight, tax and tip. Amounts are rounded to cents and always add up to the total.
  • Subscription Cost Tracker (Monthly and Yearly Total)Paste your subscriptions with price and billing cycle to get the monthly and yearly total, sorted by cost with each one's share.
  • EU Distance Selling Threshold Tracker (EUR 10,000)Track monthly B2C sales to customers in other EU countries against the EUR 10,000 Union-wide threshold, with headroom and the month you pass it.
  • Late Payment Interest Calculator (EU Directive 2011/7/EU)Statutory interest on an overdue B2B invoice at the reference rate plus 8 points, with the fixed EUR 40 recovery sum, split across the semesters you enter.
  • Payment Terms Due Date Calculator (Net 30, Net 60, End of Month)Due date for an invoice from its date and a payment term such as net 14, net 30, net 60 or end of month plus days, with the days left until it falls due.
  • Income Tax Bracket Calculator (Progressive Brackets, Marginal and Effective Rate)Apply progressive tax brackets that you enter to an income. Shows tax per bracket, the marginal rate, the average (effective) rate and the net amount.
  • Capital Gains Tax Calculator (Holding Period, Exemption and Losses)Estimate tax on the gain from selling an asset with your rates: short and long holding-period rates, an annual exempt amount, losses and costs.
  • Corporate Tax Estimator (Flat or Two-Tier Rate)Estimate company profit tax at the rate you enter, with an optional reduced rate on the first slice of profit and losses brought forward.
  • Withholding Tax Calculator (Net from Gross, Gross-Up from Net)Compute withholding on a payment and the net amount, or the gross amount you must invoice so that a chosen net arrives after withholding.
  • Mileage Allowance Calculator (Business Kilometres at Your Rate)Calculate a mileage reimbursement from kilometres driven at a per-km rate, with an optional lower rate above a distance threshold.
  • Per Diem Allowance Calculator (Business Trip Daily Allowance)Add up a business trip allowance from departure and return times, your full-day and part-day rates and meals provided. You enter the rates.
  • Depreciation Calculator (Straight-Line, Declining Balance, Sum-of-Years)Depreciation schedule for an asset from cost, residual value and life in years, using straight-line, declining-balance or sum-of-the-years-digits.

Calculators – Health (31)

  • BMI CalculatorBody mass index with WHO category.
  • BMR & TDEE CalculatorMifflin-St Jeor basal metabolic rate and daily calories.
  • Body Fat Calculator (US Navy)Body fat % from tape measurements (cm).
  • Macro CalculatorSplit calories into carbs, protein and fat grams.
  • Pregnancy Due Date CalculatorEstimated due date from last period or conception date.
  • Daily Water Intake CalculatorRough daily hydration target.
  • Ideal Weight CalculatorDevine, Robinson, Miller and Hamwi formulas.
  • Heart Rate ZonesTraining zones from max heart rate (Karvonen if resting HR given).
  • One-Rep Max (1RM) Calculator with Percentage TableEstimate your one-rep max from a weight and the reps you managed, with the Epley, Brzycki, Lombardi and Mayhew formulas, and a table of training weights by percentage.
  • Dog Age in Human Years CalculatorConvert a dog's age to human years with the 2020 epigenetic-clock formula (16 x ln(age) + 31) and the older 7-year and size-based rules, and show the life stage.
  • Sleep Cycle Calculator (Bedtime and Wake-Up Times)Find bedtimes that match a wake-up time, or wake-up times for a bedtime, in 90-minute sleep cycles with 15 minutes to fall asleep.
  • Intermittent Fasting Window PlannerPlan an eating window for 16:8, 18:6, 20:4, OMAD or 5:2: enter when you finish your last meal or want to start eating, and see the fasting and eating windows and a day schedule.
  • Calorie Deficit Calculator (Daily Target and Goal Date)Turn a weekly weight-loss rate into a daily calorie target and an estimated goal date, from Mifflin-St Jeor maintenance calories and a 7,700 kcal per kg rule of thumb.
  • Protein Intake Calculator (Daily Grams by Goal)Get a daily protein range in grams from your body weight and training goal, using the ISSN position stand ranges for exercisers, plus a split across meals.
  • Waist-to-Height Ratio Calculator (Under 0.5 Rule)Divide waist by height and see the ratio against the 0.5 rule and the NICE bands, with the waist size that would put you at 0.5.
  • Waist-to-Hip Ratio Calculator (WHO Cut-offs)Divide waist by hip and compare the ratio with the WHO cut-offs of 0.90 for men and 0.85 for women for increased metabolic risk.
  • Lean Body Mass Calculator (Boer, James and Hume)Estimate lean body mass and fat mass from weight, height and sex with the Boer, James and Hume formulas side by side.
  • Running Pace Calculator (Pace, Time or Distance with Splits)Fill in any two of distance, time and pace to get the third, with split times per kilometre or mile and the speed in km/h and mph.
  • Race Time Predictor (Riegel Formula for 5K to Marathon)Predict 5K, 10K, half marathon and marathon times from a recent race result with the Riegel formula, with the pace for each distance.
  • VO2 Max Estimator (Cooper 12-Minute Test or Heart Rate Ratio)Estimate VO2 max in ml/kg/min from the distance covered in a 12-minute run (Cooper) or from maximum and resting heart rate (Uth).
  • Calories Burned Calculator by Activity (MET Values)Estimate calories burned for walking, running, cycling, swimming and gym activities from MET values in the 2011 Compendium of Physical Activities, your weight and the minutes spent.
  • Steps to Distance Converter (Kilometres, Miles and Calories)Turn a step count into distance walked and estimated calories, from your height or your own stride length and walking speed.
  • Cycling Power and Speed Calculator (Watts, Weight, Gradient)Estimate steady cycling speed from power, rider and bike weight, gradient and riding position, or the watts needed for a target speed.

  • kubeconfig ValidatorValidate a kubectl kubeconfig: required fields, clusters / users / contexts cross-references, current-context, duplicate or unused entries, server URLs, certificate-authority-data and client-certificate-data base64 / PEM sanity, exec plugins, and risky settings (insecure-skip-tls-verify, embedded tokens). Credentials are never printed.
  • Helm Values & Template EvaluatorRender a Helm-style Go template against a values.yaml without a cluster: .Values / .Release / .Chart lookups, --set style overrides, pipelines (default, quote, upper, indent, nindent, toYaml, b64enc, printf...), if / else / range / with, variables and whitespace trimming. Not supported: named templates (define / include / tpl), lookup, sha256sum and Sprig functions beyond the common ones.
  • Caddyfile to nginx ConverterConvert common Caddyfile site blocks to nginx server blocks: reverse_proxy (with matchers and multiple upstreams), root / file_server, encode gzip, redir, respond, header, try_files, rewrite, handle / handle_path, php_fastcgi and tls. Automatic HTTPS becomes an explicit 443 server plus a 301 redirect server with placeholder certificate paths. Unsupported directives are left as comments; always review the result.
  • nginx to Caddyfile ConverterConvert nginx server blocks to a Caddyfile: server_name / listen -> site addresses, root, location (prefix, exact, regex) -> handle / handle_path, proxy_pass (including upstream groups) -> reverse_proxy, return/redirect -> redir / respond, add_header -> header, gzip -> encode, try_files, fastcgi_pass -> php_fastcgi, ssl_certificate -> tls. HTTP to HTTPS redirect servers are dropped (Caddy does it automatically). Unsupported directives are left as comments.
  • Terraform HCL to JSONParse Terraform / HCL2 configuration into JSON. Labeled blocks nest by label (resource.aws_instance.web), unlabeled blocks become arrays, non-literal expressions (references, function calls, conditionals, for expressions) are kept as "${...}" strings as in the Terraform JSON syntax. Comments and heredocs are handled; dynamic blocks are not expanded.
  • Terraform HCL to YAMLParse Terraform / HCL2 configuration and print it as YAML using the same structure as the Terraform JSON syntax (labeled blocks nested, unlabeled blocks as lists, expressions as "${...}" strings).
  • YAML / JSON to Terraform HCLTurn YAML or JSON in Terraform JSON-syntax shape (resource: {type: {name: {...}}}, variable:, output:, locals:, provider:, terraform:) into HCL. Strings that are a single "${...}" expression are written unquoted, lists of mappings become repeated nested blocks, known block names (lifecycle, connection, ...) become blocks, other mappings (tags, etc.) stay attribute maps. Output is aligned like terraform fmt.
  • Kubernetes Resource & Node Sizing CalculatorCalculate total CPU / memory requests and limits for a Deployment (replicas, optional HPA max), the QoS class (Guaranteed / Burstable / BestEffort), the overcommit ratio, and how many worker nodes you need given node size, system reserve, DaemonSet overhead and the max-pods limit. Uses Kubernetes quantity syntax (500m, 0.5, 256Mi, 1Gi).
  • Git Command Builder & Cheat SheetPick a task (undo a commit, squash, rebase, cherry-pick, force-push safely, bisect, sparse clone, recover from reflog, clean, tag...) and fill in up to three parameters to get the exact git command with a short explanation and a warning for history-rewriting or destructive operations.
  • .env Sanitizer (.env to .env.example)Turn a real .env into a safe .env.example: values of secret-looking keys (PASSWORD, TOKEN, KEY, SECRET, DSN...) or secret-looking values (JWTs, AWS keys, long hex/base64, URLs with embedded passwords) are replaced by placeholders; comments, blank lines and order are preserved. Non-secret settings can be kept or blanked. Runs locally; nothing is uploaded.
  • Docker Compose Environment GeneratorTwo-way helper: from a .env file generate a compose "environment:" block with ${VAR:-default} interpolation (or env_file usage), or from a docker-compose.yml extract every ${VAR} / ${VAR:-default} / environment key into a ready .env.example.
  • Changelog Generator (from git log)Paste `git log --pretty=format:"%h %s"` output and get a CHANGELOG.md section grouped by Conventional Commit type (feat, fix, perf...), with scopes, breaking changes (! or BREAKING CHANGE) and optional commit links. Commits that are not conventional go under "Other Changes".
  • package.json Formatter & SorterRe-order package.json keys into the conventional npm order (name, version, description ... scripts, dependencies, engines ...), sort dependency maps alphabetically, optionally sort scripts, normalise indentation and report basic problems (missing name / version, invalid semver, unpinned "latest", duplicate dependencies across sections).
  • .gitignore Pattern TesterTest which paths a .gitignore ignores and which line decides it: supports comments, negation (!), directory-only patterns (trailing /), anchored patterns, *, ?, [a-z] ranges and ** wildcards, last-match-wins, and the rule that a file inside an ignored directory cannot be re-included. Single .gitignore file semantics (no nested files, no global excludes). Paths ending in / are treated as directories.
  • Next.js Metadata GeneratorGenerate a Next.js App Router `metadata` export (or generateMetadata) with title template, description, canonical, Open Graph, Twitter card, robots, icons and verification fields, or the equivalent Pages Router <Head> tags.
  • Service Worker GeneratorGenerate a service worker with precache, cache-first, network-first or stale-while-revalidate routing, an offline fallback page and the registration snippet.
  • CORS Policy BuilderBuild CORS response headers for nginx, Apache, Express, Caddy or a Cloudflare Worker, with allowlist handling and the credentials-with-wildcard check.
  • CircleCI Config Generator (.circleci/config.yml)Build a CircleCI config for Node, Python, Go or Docker projects: executor image, dependency caching, test commands, a workflow with optional deploy job on main.
  • Jenkinsfile Generator (Declarative Pipeline)Generate a declarative Jenkins pipeline with agent, environment, stages for build, test and deploy, post actions, timeouts and a branch condition for deployment.
  • Apache Virtual Host Generator (HTTPS, Redirect, Proxy)Generate an Apache VirtualHost for a site: HTTP to HTTPS redirect, TLS paths, document root or reverse proxy, security headers, gzip and logging.
  • Conventional Commit Linter (commitlint Rules in the Browser)Check commit messages against the default commitlint conventional rules: type list, lower-case type, subject, full stop, header length, blank lines and line length. Several messages can be separated by a line of three dashes.
  • GitLab CI Linter: .gitlab-ci.yml Structure CheckCheck .gitlab-ci.yml for YAML errors, jobs without script, unknown stages, needs and extends that point nowhere, bad when values and keywords outside the documented list. It does not call GitLab.
  • tsconfig.json Explainer: What Each Option DoesPaste a tsconfig.json (comments and trailing commas are fine) and get one plain-language line per option, its value, and a review list for unknown options and risky settings.
  • SSH Config Builder: ~/.ssh/config Host EntriesTurn one line per server into ready ~/.ssh/config Host blocks: alias, host name, user, port, identity file, jump host and keep-alive options.

  • Bubble LevelSpirit level using your device accelerometer. Lay the phone flat on a surface.
  • Screen RulerOn-screen ruler in cm, inches or pixels. Calibrate against a bank card for real-world accuracy.

  • Keyboard Event ViewerPress any key to see key, code, keyCode, location and modifier values.
  • Gamepad TesterConnect a controller, press a button, and see live button and axis values.
  • Screen InfoResolution, pixel ratio, colour depth, touch points, orientation and display capabilities.
  • Mouse Click Speed TestHow many clicks per second can you do? Pick a duration and start clicking.
  • Display Test (Dead Pixels, Colours, Refresh Rate)Check a screen for dead or stuck pixels with full-screen solid colours you step through yourself, a gradient banding strip, and measure the refresh rate with a timing test. No flashing: colours change only when you press a button.
  • GPS Speedometer & Position (Device Location)Show your speed, heading, altitude and coordinates from the device GPS, in km/h, mph or knots, with trip distance and max speed. Location is read by your browser and never sent anywhere by this page.

  • Clipboard Inspector (Formats, HTML and Files You Paste)Paste anything into the box and see every format the clipboard carried: plain text, HTML source, rich text, images and files, with sizes. Useful for debugging copy and paste. Runs locally.

Documents (17)

  • Elevator Pitch Generator From Problem, Solution and AudienceFill in who you help, the problem, your solution and proof to get pitch drafts in two structures with word count and speaking time.
  • Vesting Schedule Calculator (Cliff and Monthly Vesting)Shares vested at each month for a cliff plus monthly schedule, and the vested amount on a date you choose.
  • Project Quote Estimator From Tasks, Hours and RatesTotal a project from tasks with hours and rates, add contingency, discount and tax, and see the price, hours and blended rate.
  • Lean Canvas Builder (One-Page Business Plan)Fill in the nine boxes of a lean canvas as short lists and get a printable one-page canvas you can save as HTML or print to PDF.
  • Business Model Canvas Builder (Nine Blocks)Write notes in the nine blocks of the business model canvas and get a printable one-page canvas as HTML you can save or print to PDF.
  • Market Size Calculator (TAM, SAM, SOM)Estimate total, serviceable and obtainable market from customer counts, price per customer and the shares you assume, bottom-up.
  • OKR Planner and Progress ScorerWrite objectives with measurable key results and see each key result scored from start, target and current values, with objective averages.
  • RACI Matrix Builder With Role ChecksTurn tasks and role assignments into a RACI table and flag tasks with no accountable owner, several accountable owners or nobody responsible.

Games (5)

  • 2048Slide and merge tiles. Arrow keys, swipe or buttons. Best score is saved locally.
  • Memory MatchFlip cards and find all pairs in the fewest moves. Best score saved locally.
  • Minesweeper9x9 board with 10 mines. Right-click or use flag mode to flag. Best time saved locally.
  • Bingo Card Generator (75-Ball or Custom Words, Printable)Create printable bingo cards: classic 75-ball cards with B-I-N-G-O columns or 5x5 cards from your own words, with a free centre space and a caller list.
  • L-System Fractal Generator (Koch, Dragon, Plant, Hilbert)Draw Lindenmayer-system fractals from presets or your own axiom and rules: the expanded string, turtle drawing as SVG, and symbol counts. Downloadable SVG.

Learning (23)

  • Flashcards (Leitner)Leitner boxes with 1/2/4/8/16-day intervals. Cards stay in this browser.
  • Kanban BoardThree-column board saved in this browser.
  • Mind Map MakerEdit a tree of ideas and export it as a Markdown outline.
  • Huffman Coding Calculator: Codes, Entropy and CompressionBuild a Huffman code for your text: symbol frequencies, the prefix code for each symbol, the encoded bit string, average code length, Shannon entropy and compression ratio.
  • Elementary Cellular Automaton Generator (Rule 30, 90, 110, Any Rule 0-255)Generate Wolfram elementary cellular automata for any rule from 0 to 255: text and SVG output, with wrap-around or fixed edges and a single-cell or random start.
  • Boolean Expression Minimizer: Truth Table, Karnaugh Map, Quine-McCluskeySimplify a Boolean function from its minterms (and don't-cares): minimal sum-of-products expression, prime implicants and a Karnaugh map for 2 to 4 variables.
  • Printable Math Worksheet Generator with Answer KeyMake arithmetic worksheets with the operation, number range and problem count you choose, plus a separate answer page to print or save as PDF.
  • Multiple-Choice Quiz Builder (Self-Contained HTML Quiz File)Write questions with answer options, mark the correct ones, and download one HTML file that anyone can open to take the quiz and see the score.
  • Fraction Visualizer: Pie and Bar Models with ComparisonDraw one or more fractions such as 3/8 as shaded circle slices and bars, compare two fractions side by side, and see the equivalent decimal.
  • Number Line Tool: Show Addition and Subtraction as JumpsType a problem like -3 + 5 or 2 - 7 + 4 and see each step drawn as a jump on a number line from the start to the answer.
  • Guitar and Ukulele Chord Finder with Fingering DiagramsType chord names such as Am7, F#m or Bb and get several fingering diagrams computed from the notes of the chord for guitar or ukulele.
  • Handwriting Tracing Worksheet Maker (Dotted Letters, Printable)Type letters, words or sentences and print a worksheet with dotted tracing text on guide lines, followed by blank practice lines.
  • Word Search Puzzle Maker with Answer KeyHide your word list in a letter grid in the directions you choose and print the puzzle with a word list and a marked answer key.
  • Crossword Puzzle Maker from Words and CluesEnter answer words with clues and get an interlocking crossword grid with numbered across and down clue lists and an answer grid.
  • Classroom Seating Chart Generator (Random, Printable)Paste a class list, set the number of desk rows and columns, and get a shuffled seating plan with optional aisles, ready to print.
  • Multiplication Table Trainer with Timed DrillsPractise chosen times tables in random order with an optional time limit, then see your score and the facts you missed most.
  • Ear Training: Identify Intervals, Chords and Scales by EarListen to an interval, chord or scale and pick its name; the trainer tracks your accuracy for each type.
  • Sight Reading Trainer: Name the Note on the StaffNotes appear on a treble or bass staff and you name them by button or letter key, with timing and an error summary.
  • Virtual Piano with Computer Keyboard, Octaves and Melody RecorderPlay a piano with the mouse, touch or your computer keys, switch octave and sound, and record a short melody to play back.
  • Learn to Read an Analog Clock (Read It or Set It)Children read the time on a clock face and type it, or set the hands with sliders to match a written time, with instant feedback.
  • Spelling Practice: Hear the Word, Type the SpellingEnter a word list and your browser reads each word aloud with speech synthesis; you type the spelling and get a score at the end.
  • Reading Speed Test: Words per MinuteRead a passage at your own pace, press stop, and get your words-per-minute; paste your own text to test with material you choose.
  • Morse Code Trainer: Copy by Ear with the Koch MethodHear random Morse groups at your chosen speed, type what you hear, and add new characters one by one as your accuracy improves.

Dev Extras (21)

  • CSS Selector TesterPaste HTML and a selector to see what matches.
  • HTML Tag StripperRemove tags, scripts, styles and comments; decode entities.
  • HTTP Basic Auth Header GeneratorEncode user:password into an Authorization header and snippets.
  • JSON Lines <-> JSON ArrayConvert JSONL/NDJSON to a JSON array and back.
  • String Case DetectorDetect camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case and more per line.
  • Semver CalculatorCompare versions, bump them, and test npm-style ranges (^ ~ >= < x-ranges, hyphen, ||).
  • Commit Message Suggester (from git diff)Paste a unified git diff and get a Conventional Commits subject and body drafted from the files and changes. Heuristic, no AI, nothing uploaded.
  • Stack Trace Formatter (Java, Python, JavaScript, .NET, Go)Paste an exception or stack trace and get the error, message, "caused by" chain and a clean frame list, with library frames collapsed so your own code stands out.
  • Semver Range IntersectionFind the versions that satisfy two npm semver ranges at once (for example two packages that need different ranges of a shared dependency), or learn that they cannot both be met.
  • Shell Script Portability Checker (Bashisms in #!/bin/sh)Find bash-only syntax ([[ ]], arrays, ${var//x/y}, <<<, source, local, echo -e, brace ranges) that breaks scripts run by dash, ash or busybox sh, with the POSIX replacement.
  • File Type Detector (Magic Bytes)Identify what a file really is from its first bytes (not its extension): images, archives, documents, audio, video, fonts, executables. Shows hex header and flags extension mismatches.
  • Gzip Inspector (Header, CRC, Ratio)Read the header of a .gz file (original name, timestamp, OS, flags), verify its CRC-32 and size by decompressing in the browser, and show the compression ratio.
  • Shell Command Builder (tar, find, rsync, ssh, openssl, dump)Build safely quoted commands for common jobs: tar, find, du, rsync, scp, ssh tunnels, self-signed certificates, database dumps, curl downloads and grep, each with a plain-English note on the flags.
  • 3D Model Viewer (STL, OBJ, PLY, GLB, 3MF) with Volume and SizeOpen an STL, OBJ or PLY mesh in the browser, rotate it with sliders or buttons, and read its dimensions, triangle count, surface area and volume (for 3D printing checks). Nothing is uploaded.
  • SSML Builder: Speech Markup for Voice Assistants and TTSTurn text into SSML with pauses between paragraphs, speaking rate, pitch, volume, emphasis, spelled-out numbers and a voice name. Output is well-formed XML for Alexa, Google, Azure and Polly.
  • Open Source Licence Compatibility Matrix (Not Legal Advice)List the SPDX licences of your dependencies (MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0-only, MPL-2.0, ... also (A OR B) expressions) and see which licences the combined work can use, with the rule and source behind each answer. Information only, not legal advice.
  • TrueType Font Subsetter (TTF / WOFF)Cut a TrueType font down to the characters you use: keeps those glyphs (and composite parts), rebuilds cmap, glyf, loca and metrics, and saves a much smaller TTF or WOFF. Hand-written, checked against fontTools. Drops kerning and ligatures. Check the font licence first.
  • Pull Request Description Generator (from a git diff)Paste a git diff and get a ready PR description: summary of files by area, added and removed lines, test and dependency notes, migrations, TODOs added and a review checklist. Rule-based, runs locally.
  • WebAssembly Text and Binary Converter (WAT to WASM, WASM to WAT)Assemble WAT text into a .wasm binary or disassemble a .wasm (hex or base64) into WAT. Hand-written for the core instruction set plus bulk memory, reference types, multi-value and sign extension. Validates with the browser.
  • JavaScript AST Explorer (ESTree Tree View)Parse JavaScript (ES2022 scripts) into an ESTree syntax tree with node types, properties and source ranges, shown as an indented tree or JSON. Also explores JSON. Hand-written parser.
  • JavaScript Obfuscator (Local Variables, String Array, Minify)Make JavaScript harder to read with token-level transforms that are safe without a full parser: rename local variables, move strings into an array, hex-escape strings and numbers, strip comments and white space.

Archives & Spreadsheets (9)

  • ZIP CreatorPack several files into a .zip in your browser (deflate, stored fallback; max 4 GB, no encryption).
  • ZIP ExtractorOpen a .zip and download its files one by one. Stored + deflate entries only; ZIP64 and encrypted entries are reported as unsupported.
  • ZIP InspectorList the contents of a .zip (names, sizes, method, CRC, date) without extracting anything.
  • JSON to XLSXConvert a JSON array of objects (or arrays) to an Excel .xlsx file with a bold, frozen header row and typed numbers.
  • CSV to XLSXConvert CSV text to an Excel .xlsx file. Numbers become numeric cells (leading-zero values like 007 stay text).
  • XLSX to CSV ViewerRead an .xlsx in your browser: lists sheet names and prints one sheet as CSV (cached formula values; dates show as serial numbers).
  • Excel (XLSX) to JSON ConverterConvert one sheet of an .xlsx workbook to JSON in your browser: an array of objects keyed by the header row, or an array of arrays. Numbers and booleans are typed; dates arrive as Excel serial numbers.
  • SQLite Database Viewer (.sqlite, .db)Open a SQLite file in the browser: list tables, schema SQL and row counts, and browse the first rows of every table. Read-only, nothing is uploaded.
  • Parquet File Viewer and CSV Converter (Flat Tables)Open a Parquet file in the browser: schema, row count, row groups, compression and the first rows, or convert them to CSV. Reads Snappy, gzip and uncompressed files with common encodings. Local only.

Hashing – bcrypt (2)

  • Bcrypt Hash GeneratorHash passwords with bcrypt ($2a/$2b, cost 4-14) entirely in your browser. One password per line. Only the first 72 bytes count (bcrypt limit). Cost 12 takes a second or so.
  • Bcrypt Hash VerifierCheck a password against a bcrypt hash ($2a/$2b/$2y, cost up to 16). Runs locally; nothing is sent anywhere.

PDF (42)

  • Text to PDFTurn plain text into a multi-page PDF (A4/Letter, standard Helvetica/Times/Courier, WinAnsi characters, optional header and page numbers).
  • Markdown to PDFRender a Markdown subset (headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, fenced code) to a text-only PDF. Inline emphasis is stripped; no images or tables.
  • Images to PDFCombine images into one PDF, one per page. JPEGs are embedded untouched; PNG/WebP/GIF are re-encoded (PNG transparency can be kept losslessly).
  • PDF InfoInspect a plain, non-encrypted PDF: version, page count, Info fields, producer, encryption, object streams. Best effort (regex based; no repair of broken files).
  • PDF Text Extractor (simple)Best-effort text from PDFs whose content streams are uncompressed or Flate-compressed and use simple fonts. Will NOT work for subset-encoded / Type0 / Identity-H fonts (most Word, Chrome, LaTeX output) or scanned pages.
  • Merge PDFsCombine several PDFs into one, in the order selected. Works on existing PDFs without re-rendering; bookmarks and form fields are dropped.
  • Split PDFSplit a PDF into several files: every N pages, or custom ranges (each comma-separated range becomes its own file).
  • Extract PDF PagesPull selected pages (e.g. 1-3,5,7-) out of a PDF into a new PDF.
  • Delete PDF PagesRemove selected pages (e.g. 2,4-6) from a PDF.
  • Reorder PDF PagesRearrange pages by an order list such as 3,1,2,4-6 (pages you leave out are dropped, a page may be repeated, 6-4 reverses a run).
  • Rotate PDF PagesRotate all pages or a range by 90, 180 or 270 degrees clockwise (adds to any existing rotation).
  • Reverse PDF Page OrderPut the pages of a PDF in reverse order.
  • PDF Page Count and SizesList the number of pages with each page size, rotation and paper format (A4, Letter...).
  • PDF Metadata EditorEdit Title, Author, Subject, Keywords, Creator and Producer. Leave a field empty to keep it, type - to delete it. The old XMP packet is dropped so it cannot contradict the new values.
  • Remove PDF MetadataStrip the Info dictionary (author, title, creator...) and XMP metadata packets from a PDF.
  • Add Page Numbers to PDFStamp page numbers (Helvetica) onto existing pages. Honors page rotation and crop offsets. Use {n} for the number and {N} for the total.
  • Add Text Watermark to PDFOverlay light diagonal text (semi-transparent) on every page of an existing PDF.
  • Crop PDF MarginsTrim margins from every page by setting its CropBox (and optionally MediaBox). Margins refer to the page as displayed. Content is not deleted.
  • Base64 to PDFDecode a Base64 string (or data:application/pdf;base64, URI) into a downloadable PDF file after checking for the %PDF header.
  • PDF to Image (PNG, JPEG, WebP)Render PDF pages to PNG, JPEG or WebP images with a built-in renderer (nothing is uploaded). Text, vector graphics, gradients, patterns, transparency and images are supported; JBIG2/JPEG2000 images show as grey boxes.
  • PDF Thumbnail Sheet (Contact Sheet)Render the pages of a PDF as small thumbnails on one image, with page numbers.
  • PDF Dark Mode Converter (Invert for Night Reading)Convert a PDF to a dark-background version for reading at night: invert colours while keeping hues, or use a sepia or plain inversion. Pages are rendered to images, so text is no longer selectable.
  • PDF Redaction (Black Out Areas Permanently)Black out sensitive areas of a PDF by page and position (percent of the page). Pages are flattened to images, so the covered text is really gone, not just hidden under a box.
  • PDF Compare (Visual Difference Between Two PDFs)Compare two versions of a PDF page by page: pages are rendered and differences are highlighted in red, with the percentage changed and where. Works for scans, text and layout.
  • Compress PDFMake a PDF smaller without re-rendering it: deflate uncompressed streams, recompress Flate streams, drop objects nothing refers to and optionally downsample JPEG images.
  • Password Protect PDFEncrypt a PDF with the standard security handler: AES-256, AES-128 or RC4-128, with a password to open it and permission flags (print, copy, edit). Encrypted in your browser.
  • Remove PDF Password (Unlock)Remove the password and restrictions from a PDF you can open, by giving its user or owner password. Handles RC4-40/128, AES-128 and AES-256. Nothing is uploaded.
  • Annotate PDF (Text, Highlight, Shapes, Drawing)Add text, highlight boxes, rectangles, lines and freehand strokes to a PDF. One line per annotation, positions in points from the top-left of the page. Real annotations or burned into the page.
  • Fill PDF Form FieldsFill AcroForm text fields, checkboxes, radio buttons and drop-downs in a PDF, optionally flatten the form so the values become fixed page content. Run without values to list the fields.
  • DOCX to PDF (Text Only)Turn the text of a Word .docx into a simple paginated PDF: headings, paragraphs, bullets and table rows in Helvetica. No images, fonts, columns or exact Word layout.
  • PDF Text Extractor with Layout (Subset Fonts)Pull the text out of a PDF page by page, including files whose fonts are subset or embedded (Word, Chrome, LaTeX, InDesign), using each font's Unicode map. Optional layout mode keeps column gaps. Built-in reader, no pdf.js.
  • PDF Table Extractor to CSVFind tables in the text layer of a PDF and export them as CSV. Rows are lines of text with two or more cells; columns are the vertical gaps in the table. A heuristic, so check the preview.
  • PDF OCR: Make a Scanned PDF SearchableRecognise the text on scanned PDF pages with the built-in English OCR and add it as an invisible text layer, so you can search and copy from the file. Original pages are kept as they are.
  • PDF Image ExtractorSave the images embedded in a PDF as separate files: JPEG images are copied untouched, others are written as PNG (with transparency when the PDF has a soft mask). Lists what could not be extracted.
  • PDF N-Up Printer (Several Pages per Sheet)Place 2, 4, 6, 8, 9, 12 or 16 pages of a PDF on each sheet for handouts and proofs. Choose sheet size, orientation, margins, gaps and a border. Pages stay vector (no rasterising).
  • PDF Booklet Maker (Saddle-Stitch Order)Reorder and place the pages of a PDF two per sheet in saddle-stitch order, so printing double-sided on the short edge, folding and stapling gives a booklet. Pads to a multiple of 4 pages with blanks.
  • PDF Bookmark Editor (Outline)Read the bookmarks (outline) of a PDF as editable text, or write a new outline from lines like "Chapter 1 | 3" with indentation for sub-levels, and save the PDF with working bookmarks.
  • PDF Flattener (Annotations and Form Fields)Burn comments, highlights, stamps and filled form fields into the page content so they can no longer be edited or hidden. Optionally keeps links. Uses the appearance streams already in the file.
  • PDF Grayscale ConverterMake a colour PDF print in gray. Each page gets a gray layer in the Saturation blend mode, so text and vector art stay sharp and selectable. The file size does not shrink.
  • PDF Blank Page InserterInsert blank or separator pages at chosen positions in a PDF, for example after pages 2 and 5, or at the start. Each blank page takes the size of the page before it.
  • PDF Image Watermark and StampStamp a logo or image on the pages of a PDF: choose one PDF and one PNG, JPEG or WebP file together. Set position, size, opacity and angle, or tile it across the page. PNG transparency is kept.
  • PDF Signer (Draw or Type a Signature)Draw or type your signature, place it on a PDF page with a live preview, and save the signed copy. This adds a picture of your signature, not a cryptographic digital signature.

Crypto (52)

  • Keccak-256 / SHA-3 HasherHand-written Keccak-f[1600]: Ethereum Keccak-256 (not NIST SHA3-256), Keccak-512 and SHA3-224/256/384/512. Shows the 4-byte selector for function signatures.
  • X.509 CSR DecoderDecode a PEM certificate signing request (PKCS#10): subject, public key, signature algorithm, requested SANs / key usage, SHA-256 fingerprint.
  • RSA PKCS#1 / PKCS#8 PEM ConverterConvert RSA keys between PKCS#1 (BEGIN RSA PRIVATE/PUBLIC KEY) and PKCS#8 / SPKI (BEGIN PRIVATE/PUBLIC KEY). Auto-detects direction.
  • Ed25519 Key Pair GeneratorGenerate an Ed25519 key pair with WebCrypto: PKCS#8 private PEM, SPKI public PEM, OpenSSH public key line and raw hex. Keys never leave your browser.
  • RSA Key Pair GeneratorGenerate an RSA key pair with WebCrypto: PKCS#8 private key and SPKI public key as PEM (optional PKCS#1 format). Nothing is uploaded.
  • PKCE Generator (OAuth code_verifier / challenge)Generate an RFC 7636 code_verifier, its S256 code_challenge, plus random state and nonce. Paste your own verifier to compute its challenge.
  • htpasswd Generator (apr1 / SHA-1)Create Apache/nginx .htpasswd lines from user:password pairs with apr1 (MD5) or {SHA}. For bcrypt use the bcrypt-generator tool.
  • PBKDF2 Key DerivationDerive a key from a password with PBKDF2 (WebCrypto) using SHA-1/256/384/512; output as hex and Base64.
  • UUID v5 / v3 Name-Based GeneratorDeterministic UUIDs from a namespace and name (RFC 9562): v5 uses SHA-1, v3 uses MD5. One name per line.
  • UUID v7 / v1 Timestamp ExtractorRead the embedded creation time (and version, variant) from UUIDs. v7 stores Unix milliseconds, v1/v6 store 100 ns ticks since 1582.
  • SSH Public Key InspectorParse an OpenSSH public key line: type, size, comment and the SHA-256 / MD5 fingerprints shown by ssh-keygen -l.
  • Solana Address ValidatorValidate Solana public keys: Base58 alphabet, 32-byte length, and whether the key lies on the ed25519 curve (wallet) or off it (PDA).
  • Solidity ABI Encoder / DecoderEncode values or decode calldata with the Ethereum ABI: uintN/intN, address, bool, bytesN, bytes, string, arrays and tuples. Accepts a function signature to add the 4-byte selector.
  • BIP-39 Mnemonic Generator & ValidatorGenerate a BIP-39 English recovery phrase (12/15/18/21/24 words, crypto.getRandomValues or your own entropy hex), validate an existing phrase checksum, and derive the 512-bit seed (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512, 2048 rounds). Runs locally, but never use a phrase generated or pasted into any website for real funds.
  • Bech32 / SegWit Address Encoder & DecoderDecode or encode Bech32 (BIP-173) and Bech32m (BIP-350) strings: Bitcoin SegWit/Taproot addresses (bc1, tb1), also generic bech32 such as npub or lightning HRPs. Shows witness version, program and scriptPubKey.
  • Ethereum Signed Message (EIP-191) VerifierRecover the signer address of a personal_sign / eth_sign (EIP-191 version 0x45) signature using hand-written secp256k1 and Keccak-256, and compare with an expected address.
  • Ed25519 Sign & VerifyGenerate an Ed25519 key pair, sign a message from a 32-byte hex seed, or verify a signature against a public key, using WebCrypto (needs a browser/runtime with Ed25519 support).
  • CSR Builder (with SAN)Generate a new key pair in your browser and a PKCS#10 certificate signing request with Subject Alternative Names (DNS, IP, email, URI). Output is the CSR PEM and the private key (PKCS#8 PEM); nothing leaves the page.
  • Argon2 Parameter TunerPick Argon2id memory, iterations and parallelism for a target hashing time and memory budget. A calculator, not a benchmark: it does not run Argon2; calibrate the throughput value by timing one hash in your stack.
  • BLAKE2b / BLAKE2s HashHand-written BLAKE2b (1-64 byte digest) and BLAKE2s (1-32) with optional MAC key, per RFC 7693. Input as text, hex or base64.
  • BLAKE3 Hash / Keyed / Derive KeyHand-written BLAKE3 with the three official modes: hash, keyed_hash (32-byte key) and derive_key (context string), plus extendable output of any length.
  • HKDF Key Derivation (RFC 5869)HKDF extract-and-expand with SHA-1/256/384/512 from input key material, salt and info.
  • scrypt Key DerivationHand-written scrypt (RFC 7914) on PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 and Salsa20/8. Memory 128*N*r capped at 64 MiB; yields to the UI while working.
  • Argon2d / Argon2i / Argon2idHand-written Argon2 (RFC 9106, v1.3) with memory, iterations, parallelism, tag length, secret and associated data. Raw hex or PHC string. Memory capped at 64 MiB; the UI stays responsive.
  • Argon2 PHC Hash VerifierCheck a password against a $argon2id$v=19$m=..,t=..,p=..$salt$hash string (Argon2d/i/id, v1.3). Constant-time compare.
  • Bech32 / Bech32m Encoder & DecoderDecode and validate bech32 (BIP173) / bech32m (BIP350) strings including SegWit/Taproot addresses, or encode hex bytes or a witness program.
  • Ethereum EIP-55 Checksum AddressConvert addresses (one per line) to EIP-55 mixed-case checksum form and validate existing checksums.
  • EIP-191 personal_sign Message HashDigest signed by personal_sign / eth_sign style wallets: keccak256("\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n" + len + message). Also version 0x00 (intended validator).
  • ENS Namehash & LabelhashEIP-137 namehash for ENS names, one per line, with every labelhash step. Normalisation is lowercase + NFC only (not the full ENSIP-15 rules).
  • RLP Encoder / DecoderEthereum Recursive Length Prefix. Encode JSON (strings "0x.." = bytes, other strings = UTF-8, numbers = integers, arrays = lists) or decode hex into nested hex strings, with canonical-form checks.
  • CREATE / CREATE2 Contract AddressPredict contract addresses: CREATE = keccak(rlp([sender, nonce])), CREATE2 = keccak(0xff ++ deployer ++ salt ++ keccak(init_code)) (EIP-1014).
  • Solidity Storage Slot CalculatorWalk a storage path through mappings, dynamic arrays, struct offsets and namespaced slots (EIP-1967 / ERC-7201) using keccak256, one operation per line.
  • EIP-712 Typed Data HashCompute the domain separator, struct hash and final signing digest (keccak256(0x1901 ++ domainSeparator ++ hashStruct)) from eth_signTypedData_v4-style JSON. Supports nested structs, arrays, bytesN, intN/uintN.
  • OpenPGP Armor / Packet InspectorPaste an ASCII-armored PGP key, signature or message: checks the CRC-24, lists packets (algorithms, curves, key sizes, creation time, user IDs, signature subpackets) and computes v4 (SHA-1) / v6 (SHA-256) fingerprints. Nothing is verified or decrypted.
  • SSH Public Key FingerprintSHA256 (base64) and legacy MD5 fingerprints of authorized_keys / .pub / known_hosts lines, with key type and size. Same output as ssh-keygen -lf.
  • Shamir Secret Sharing (GF(256))Split a secret into n shares so any k recover it (byte-wise Shamir over GF(256), random coefficients from crypto.getRandomValues), or combine shares. Shares look like k-x-hex. Fewer than k shares reveal nothing.
  • CRC-16 / CRC-32 / CRC-64 Calculator30 named CRC variants (CRC-16 ARC/CCITT/XMODEM/Modbus/X-25..., CRC-32 and 32C, CRC-64 XZ/ECMA/Redis) computed with hand-written table CRCs. Shows hex, decimal and the little-endian byte form.
  • xxHash / MurmurHash3 / FNV-1a / SipHashFast non-cryptographic hashes, hand-written: xxHash32/64, MurmurHash3 x86_32, FNV-1/1a (32 and 64 bit) and SipHash-2-4/1-3 with a 128-bit key. Not for security except SipHash as a keyed MAC for hash tables.
  • Luhn / Verhoeff / Damm Check DigitsValidate numbers or compute the check digit (credit card style Luhn, Verhoeff dihedral-group, Damm quasigroup). One number per line; spaces and dashes ignored.
  • ChaCha20 / Poly1305 / AEAD (RFC 8439)Hand-written ChaCha20 stream cipher, Poly1305 one-time MAC and the ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD. Defaults are the RFC 8439 section 2.8.2 test vector. Decrypt checks the tag in constant time before releasing plaintext.
  • AES CBC / CTR / GCM / ECB Demo (educational)EDUCATIONAL ONLY, not a vetted encryption product. Encrypt/decrypt with AES-CBC (PKCS#7), CTR, GCM (ciphertext||16-byte tag) or ECB (shown to demonstrate why ECB leaks patterns) via WebCrypto. Never reuse an IV/nonce with the same key; use a proper audited tool for real secrets.
  • XOR Cipher / One-Time PadXOR a message with a key. A true one-time pad needs a random key at least as long as the message and never reused; shorter keys can be repeated (Vernam/XOR cipher, easily broken) or a random pad can be generated for you.
  • Vigenere / Autokey / Beaufort / PlayfairClassical ciphers for puzzles and teaching (not secure). Vigenere, Autokey, Beaufort keep case and punctuation; Playfair works on a 5x5 square (J=I) and inserts X fillers, which stay in the decrypted text.
  • ASN.1 / DER Decoder (PEM, Hex, Base64)Parse any DER structure (certificates, keys, CSRs, PKCS#7/12 pieces) into a tree with tags, lengths, offsets, decoded OIDs, strings and times, like openssl asn1parse.
  • SSH Key Pair Generator (Ed25519, ECDSA, RSA)Generate an OpenSSH key pair in the browser: public key line for authorized_keys and an unencrypted OpenSSH private key. Keys are created with WebCrypto and never leave the page.
  • OpenPGP Passphrase Encrypt / Decrypt (gpg --symmetric Compatible)Encrypt text to an ASCII-armored OpenPGP message with a passphrase (AES-256, iterated salted S2K, integrity protected), or decrypt one made by gpg --symmetric. Runs in your browser.
  • Certificate Chain Analyzer (PEM Bundle, Signatures, Expiry, Hostname)Paste a certificate bundle (leaf plus intermediates, with or without the root): see the chain order, verify every signature with WebCrypto, check validity dates, CA flags, key sizes, weak hashes and whether a hostname matches.
  • ECDSA Key Pair Generator (P-256, P-384, P-521)Generate an elliptic-curve key pair with WebCrypto and get PKCS#8 and SPKI PEM plus public and private JWK with an RFC 7638 thumbprint. Private key never leaves the tab.
  • JWK to PEM Converter (and PEM to JWK)Convert JSON Web Keys (RSA, EC P-256/384/521, Ed25519) to PEM and PEM back to JWK. Handles a single JWK, a JWKS or PKCS#1 RSA PEM. Runs locally with WebCrypto.
  • TOTP QR Code Builder (otpauth URI)Build the otpauth:// URI and a scannable QR code for adding a 2FA account to an authenticator app. Make a random Base32 secret or use yours; shows the current code to check it.
  • Entropy Calculator (Shannon, Bits per Character)Measure the Shannon entropy of a string in bits per character and in total, and compare it with the entropy of a random string from the same character pool.
  • PGP Public Key Encrypt and Decrypt (gpg Compatible, RSA and ECDH)Encrypt a message to an armored OpenPGP public key (RSA, Curve25519, NIST P-256/384/521) or decrypt a gpg message with your private key. Hand-written OpenPGP, runs in your browser, keys never leave the page.

Formatters (21)

  • Apache Config FormatterIndent httpd.conf / .htaccess sections (<VirtualHost>, <Directory>...), tidy spacing, keep comments.
  • Docker Compose FormatterRe-indent a compose file consistently (comments kept) and optionally order top-level and service keys the conventional way.
  • TOML FormatterNormalise "key = value" spacing, blank lines before tables, array indentation; optionally sort keys inside each table.
  • Protobuf FormatterFormat .proto files: one statement per line, consistent indentation and spacing; comments are kept.
  • Tailwind Class SorterSort Tailwind CSS utility classes into the conventional order (layout, box model, typography, effects ... with variants like hover:/md:/dark: after base classes), similar to prettier-plugin-tailwindcss. Hand-written approximation of the official ordering: unknown/custom classes come first, results can differ in rare edge cases.
  • GraphQL Minifier & Syntax ValidatorCheck GraphQL queries, mutations, fragments and schema (SDL) for syntax errors with line and column, and minify by removing comments and whitespace.
  • TypeScript Formatter: Re-indent and Break Lines (No Prettier)Re-indent TypeScript or JavaScript by brace depth, fix blank lines and optionally break minified code into lines. Strings, templates, regexes and comments are left alone.
  • Go Code Formatter: Re-indent with Tabs (gofmt-Style Layout)Re-indent Go source with tabs the way gofmt lays out blocks and switch cases, fix blank lines and optionally break one-line code. It does not align comments or struct fields.
  • Rust Code Formatter: Re-indent Blocks (No rustfmt)Re-indent Rust code by brace depth with 4 spaces, keep lifetimes, raw strings and nested comments intact, and optionally break minified code into lines. It does not wrap long lines.
  • Java Code Formatter: Re-indent Classes and MethodsRe-indent Java by brace depth with 4 spaces, indent switch cases, keep text blocks and comments, and optionally break one-line code. It does not wrap lines or sort imports.
  • C and C++ Code Formatter: Re-indent Blocks (No clang-format)Re-indent C or C++ by brace depth with 2 spaces, keep preprocessor lines at column 0, indent switch cases and keep raw strings. It does not apply clang-format style presets.
  • PHP Code Formatter: Re-indent PHP Inside <?php TagsRe-indent PHP code by brace depth with 4 spaces. Text outside PHP tags, heredocs and comments are left alone. Optionally break one-line code. It does not apply PSR-12 spacing rules.
  • Lua Code Formatter: Re-indent function, if, for and end BlocksRe-indent Lua scripts by block keywords (function, if, for, while, repeat, end, until) and brackets. Strings, long strings and comments are not touched.
  • Shell Script Formatter: Re-indent if, for, while and case BlocksRe-indent Bash or POSIX shell scripts by if/fi, do/done, case/esac and brace blocks the way shfmt lays them out. Heredocs and quoted strings are left alone.
  • Python Whitespace Formatter: Indentation and Blank Lines (No Ruff)Convert mixed tabs and spaces to one indent, put two blank lines around top-level defs and classes, one around methods, strip trailing spaces. It does not change quotes or wrap lines.
  • Dockerfile Formatter: Uppercase Instructions and Tidy RUN LinesUppercase Dockerfile instructions, indent continuation lines, collapse blank lines and optionally split long RUN chains at && onto their own lines.
  • LaTeX Formatter: Indent Environments and Tidy WhitespaceIndent the content of \begin{...} and \end{...} environments and \[ \] blocks, trim trailing spaces and collapse blank lines. Verbatim-style environments are not touched.
  • Log Line Prettifier: Expand JSON Inside Log LinesFind JSON objects and arrays inside application log lines and print each as an indented block under its line, leaving the rest of the line as it was.
  • Crontab Formatter: Align Cron Entries into ColumnsLine up the minute, hour, day, month and weekday fields of crontab entries in columns. Commands, comments and variable lines are kept exactly as written.
  • Line Ending Normalizer: CRLF, LF and CR ConverterConvert text or a file between Windows (CRLF), Unix (LF) and old Mac (CR) line endings and see how many of each the file has.
  • Markdown Formatter: Lists, Headings, Tables and Blank LinesNormalise Markdown: one list marker style, renumbered ordered lists, tidy ATX headings, aligned tables, blank lines around blocks and no trailing spaces. Code blocks are left alone.
