  • JSON Lines Log Filter: Flatten Fields and Filter by Any KeyLoad newline-delimited JSON logs, flatten nested fields to dotted keys and filter by any key with =, !=, ~, >, <. Shows a level summary and a table of the matching rows.
  • Logfmt Parser: key=value Log Lines to JSON or TableConvert logfmt lines (key=value, quoted values) from Heroku, Go and other services into JSON, a table or CSV. Numbers and booleans can be typed.
  • Syslog Parser: RFC 3164 and RFC 5424 with Facility and SeverityDecode syslog lines into time, host, app, process ID and message. The <PRI> number is split into facility and severity names. Works with RFC 3164, RFC 5424 and plain /var/log/syslog lines.
  • systemd Journal Export Viewer (journalctl -o json)Read journalctl -o json output: counts per unit and priority, the noisiest messages and a table of entries. Filter by unit, minimum priority or text.
  • Docker Log Viewer: docker logs --timestamps with Streams and GapsParse docker logs --timestamps output, JSON-file driver lines or CRI lines into time, stream and message. Shows time since the previous line, level counts and filters by stream or text.
  • Kubernetes Pod Log Viewer: kubectl logs by Pod and ContainerSplit kubectl logs output (--prefix, --timestamps, --all-containers) by pod and container, merge lines in time order and filter by pod, container or text.
  • CloudFront Standard Log Parser (Tab-Separated, .gz Supported)Read CloudFront standard access logs, including gzipped files from S3. Shows cache hit ratio by result type, status codes, top URLs, edge locations and slow requests.
  • AWS ALB and Classic ELB Access Log Parser (Latency and Errors)Parse Application Load Balancer and Classic ELB access logs. Shows status codes from the balancer and the targets, latency percentiles, requests never sent to a target, and the slowest URLs.
  • S3 Server Access Log Parser: Requesters, Operations and BytesTurn S3 server access log lines into a table and a summary: who made requests, which operations, which keys, status codes, error codes and bytes sent.
  • CloudTrail Event Viewer: Who Did What, Where and WhenLoad CloudTrail JSON (a Records file, an array or JSON lines, .gz allowed) and see events by name, identity, source, region and error, with a short list of events worth a second look.
  • Cloudflare Logpush HTTP Request Log Viewer (Cache, Country, Bot Score)Summarise Cloudflare Logpush http_requests files (NDJSON, .gz allowed): cache status, status codes, countries, bot score bands, top paths and edge time to first byte.
  • CDN Edge Log Parser for Fastly and Akamai (Map Your Own Fields)Name the fields of your CDN log once (delimiter plus a list of names) and get a table with cache hit ratio, status codes, top URLs and bytes. Works with Fastly custom formats, Akamai DataStream exports and similar.
  • Google Cloud Logging Export Viewer (LogEntry JSON)Read JSON exported from Logs Explorer or a log sink. Filter by minimum severity, resource type or text, and see counts by severity and resource with the message of each entry.
  • Azure Monitor Diagnostic Log Viewer (Exported JSON Records)Parse Azure diagnostic log JSON from storage blobs, Event Hubs or Log Analytics exports into a searchable table, with counts by category, level, operation and result.
  • Vercel and Netlify Log Export Viewer (Routes, Status, Errors)Parse Vercel log drain or runtime log JSON and Netlify function log lines. Groups requests by route and status, shows error rates and the most common error messages.
  • Heroku Router Log Parser (Dyno, Service Time, H-Code Errors)Extract dyno, connect and service time, status and bytes from heroku[router] lines. Counts H-code errors such as H12 request timeout with their official titles, and ranks slow paths.
  • HAProxy HTTP Log Parser: Timers and Termination State DecoderDecode HAProxy httplog lines: client, frontend, backend/server, the Tq/Tw/Tc/Tr/Ta timers, status, bytes and the four-letter termination state such as sD-- explained in words.
  • Traefik and Caddy JSON Access Log SummaryRead JSON access logs from Traefik or Caddy and summarise requests per router or host, status codes, top paths and duration percentiles.
  • PostgreSQL Log Analyzer: Slow Queries, Errors and Lock WaitsFind slow statements (grouped by query shape), errors, lock waits, deadlocks and temporary files in a PostgreSQL server log. A small pgBadger-style summary that runs in your browser.
  • MySQL Slow Query Log Analyzer (Group by Fingerprint)Group slow queries by their fingerprint and rank by total time, average, maximum or count. Shows rows examined versus rows sent, lock time and an example of each pattern.
  • Redis SLOWLOG and MongoDB Slow Query Log ParserRank slow operations from redis-cli SLOWLOG GET output or from a mongod JSON log. Redis commands are grouped by command name, MongoDB operations by namespace, command and plan.
  • Exception Grouper: Cluster Similar Error Messages in a LogGroup error and exception lines by replacing variable parts (numbers, IDs, IPs, paths, URLs, quoted values) with placeholders. Shows count, first and last line and an example for each group.
  • Log Pattern Miner: Find Recurring Log Templates (Drain-Style)Paste thousands of log lines and get a short list of templates with <*> where lines differ, how often each occurs and an example. Uses a simplified Drain-like clustering.
  • Log Level Histogram: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR Counts Over TimeCount log lines per level in time buckets. Timestamps are detected automatically (ISO 8601, Apache, syslog, epoch) and the result is a table with bars per bucket.
  • Log Timestamp Normalizer: Mixed Formats to ISO 8601Find the timestamp in every log line (ISO, Apache, RFC 2822, syslog, logcat, epoch seconds or milliseconds) and rewrite it as ISO 8601 in one time zone. Reports how many lines used each format.
  • Multi-Log Merger: Interleave Several Logs by TimestampMerge two pasted logs plus any number of files into one chronological view. Each line gets its source name. Lines without a timestamp (stack traces) stay with the line before them.
  • Log Grep with Context: Regex Search with Before and After LinesSearch a log with a regular expression and show lines of context around each match, like grep -n -B -A. Optional match highlighting, inverted match and a match limit. Files up to a few hundred MB work; larger files are better streamed.
  • Log to CSV Converter (Access Logs, logfmt, JSON Lines, Custom Regex)Convert log lines to CSV for a spreadsheet. Pick Common/Combined, an nginx or Apache format string, logfmt, JSON lines or your own regex with named groups, then choose the columns.
  • Request Rate Spike Detector: Minutes with Unusual Traffic or ErrorsBuild a per-minute (or larger) count of requests and errors from an access log and flag buckets far above the typical level. The baseline is the median plus a multiple of the robust spread (MAD).
  • Response Time Percentile Calculator per Endpoint (p50, p90, p95, p99)Compute p50, p90, p95 and p99 latency per endpoint from an access log that records request time (nginx $request_time, Apache %D or %T). Pick the unit and group numeric IDs into one route.
  • Top IPs and User Agents Report from an Access LogRank the busiest client IPs and user agents in a Common or Combined log with request count, share of traffic, bytes, error counts and first and last request.
  • Brute-Force and Scan Detector for Access Logs (401, 404 Bursts, Probe Paths)List IPs with many failed logins (401/403 on login-like paths), bursts of 404s within a time window, and requests for well-known vulnerability probe paths. Findings are patterns to review.
  • auth.log and fail2ban Analyzer: Failed SSH Logins, Bans, sudoSummarise /var/log/auth.log (or secure) and fail2ban.log: failed and invalid-user SSH logins by IP and user, accepted logins, fail2ban bans and unbans, and sudo commands.
  • Firewall Log Parser: iptables, UFW and pfSense filterlogParse iptables and UFW kernel log lines and pfSense filterlog lines into action, interface, protocol, source, destination and ports, then rank sources, destination ports and actions.
  • Windows Event Log XML Viewer (Filter by Event ID)Read Windows events exported as XML (Event Viewer "Save All Events As", wevtutil qe /f:xml) and filter by event ID. Common Security event IDs get their Microsoft title; failed logons are summarised by account and IP.
  • Browser Console Log Cleaner: Strip Links and Group RepeatsClean pasted DevTools console output: remove file:line prefixes and VM numbers, drop known dev-server noise, and collapse repeated messages with a count.
  • Android Logcat Viewer: Filter by Tag, PID and PriorityParse adb logcat output (threadtime, time and brief formats), filter by minimum priority, tag, process ID or text, and see crashes (FATAL EXCEPTION) and ANRs. Optional colour-coded HTML view.
  • iOS Crash Report Viewer (.crash and .ips): Crashed Thread FirstFormat Apple crash reports in the older text layout or the newer .ips JSON: device and OS, exception type and codes, termination reason and the crashed thread backtrace. It does not symbolicate.
  • CI Build Log Error Extractor (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab)Find the first failure in a long CI log: the step name, the error line and the lines around it, plus a list of other error lines. ANSI colours and timestamps are removed first.
  • ANSI Escape Code Renderer: Terminal Colours to HTMLRender terminal logs with ANSI colour and style codes (16, 256 and true colour, bold, underline) as coloured HTML, copy the HTML, or strip the codes to plain text.
  • Log Format Auto-Detector: Which Parser Fits These Lines?Paste a sample of log lines and see which known format each line matches (Combined, syslog, JSON, logfmt, W3C, HAProxy, cloud logs and more), with a share per format and the tool to open next.
  • Large Log File Viewer: Page Through Multi-GB Logs Without Loading ThemOpen a very large text log and read it in pages. Only the part you look at is read from disk. Jump to a percentage of the file or search forward for text or a regex.

Fonts (5)

  • Font File Inspector: Names, Metrics, Features and CharactersRead a TTF, OTF or WOFF file: names, metrics, OpenType features, variation axes and the characters it covers.
  • Font Format Converter: TTF or OTF to WOFF with @font-face CSSPack a TTF or OTF font as WOFF for the web, or unpack WOFF back to TTF or OTF.
  • Variable Font Playground: Move Axes and Copy font-variation-settingsLoad a variable font file, move its axes and copy the CSS.
  • Font Previewer: Your Text in Many Fonts at OnceType text and see it in installed or uploaded fonts side by side.
  • Handwriting Font Maker: Draw Glyphs on a Grid and Save a TrueType FontDraw each character on a pixel grid with the mouse, touch or the keyboard (arrow keys and Space), preview your text in the new font, and download an installable TTF file. Blocky, pixel-style outlines.

Charts & Data Visualization (27)

  • Bar Chart Maker (Vertical, Horizontal, Stacked, SVG)Paste labels and values and get an accessible SVG bar chart: vertical or horizontal, grouped or stacked, one colour or a palette, with a data table as text alternative.
  • Line Chart Maker (Multi-Series Time Series to SVG)Plot one or more series as lines from a pasted table. The first column can be dates (YYYY-MM-DD), numbers or labels; gaps in the data break the line. Accessible SVG plus data table.
  • Pie and Donut Chart Maker with PercentagesEnter category names with values and get an SVG pie or donut chart with each slice labelled by its percentage, a legend and a data table.
  • Scatter Plot Maker with Trendline and Pearson CorrelationPaste X and Y columns to draw a scatter plot with a least-squares trendline, slope, intercept, Pearson r and R squared. Accessible SVG with a data table.
  • Histogram Builder with Adjustable Bin WidthBin a list of numbers into a histogram with a bin width you choose (or an automatic Sturges width), see the counts per bin, and copy the SVG.
  • Box and Whisker Plot Maker (Quartiles and Outliers)Paste one column per group to draw box plots with median, quartiles, 1.5 IQR whiskers and outlier points, plus a table of the five-number summary.
  • Heatmap Maker (Colour a Matrix by Value)Turn a grid of numbers with row and column labels into a coloured heatmap with a legend and optional cell values. Choose a colour scale; the table is the text alternative.
  • Calendar Heatmap (GitHub-Style Year of Daily Values)Paste dates with counts and see each day of a year as a square shaded by its value, with month labels and a legend. Dates must be YYYY-MM-DD; repeated dates are added together.
  • Sankey Diagram Builder (Flows from Source, Target, Amount)Enter rows of source, target and amount to draw a Sankey diagram whose bands match each flow, such as a budget split by department. Cycles are rejected. Accessible SVG with a flow table.
  • Treemap Maker (Nested Rectangles from Category Paths)Paste rows like "Documents/Reports/2025,420" and get a treemap where each rectangle has an area matching its share, with nested groups labelled. Accessible SVG with a table.
  • Sunburst Chart Maker (Hierarchy as Concentric Rings)Turn "Group/Sub/Item,value" rows into a sunburst: one ring per level, arc size by value. Zoom into a branch by typing its path (the keyboard version of clicking a segment).
  • Radar (Spider) Chart Maker for Comparing ItemsCompare several items across the same attributes. Enter a header row of attribute names and one row of scores per item; each item is drawn as a polygon on shared radial axes.
  • Gantt Chart Maker (Tasks, Durations and Dependencies)List tasks with a start date or the task they follow, plus a duration in days, and get a Gantt chart with dependency arrows and a schedule table. Calendar days, no weekends or holidays.
  • Flowchart Maker from Text Arrows (SVG)Type lines such as "Start -> Check input? -yes-> Save -> End" and get a laid-out flowchart as SVG: boxes, rounded terminals, decision diamonds and labelled arrows.
  • Mind Map Builder from an Indented Outline (SVG)Turn an indented list into a mind map drawn as an SVG tree with coloured branches. Limit the levels shown to collapse deeper branches, with a "+n" badge on collapsed nodes.
  • Network Graph Visualizer (Force-Directed Layout from an Edge List)Paste connected pairs (a,b or a -> b) and nodes arrange themselves by simulated attraction and repulsion. Components get colours, node size follows degree, and a degree table is included.
  • Org Chart Maker from a CSV of People and ManagersBuild a top-down organisation chart from rows of name, manager and optional title. People with an empty manager become the top of the tree. Loops and unknown managers are reported.
  • Timeline Maker (Dated Events on a Line, SVG)Enter events as "date | title | description" and get a horizontal or vertical timeline in date order, evenly spaced or to scale. Dates can be a year, a month or a full day.
  • Venn Diagram Maker (2 or 3 Sets with Labels in Each Region)Name two or three sets and type the text for each region. Circles are drawn with your labels in the correct overlaps. Region codes use set numbers: 1 = only the first set, 12 = first and second only, 123 = all three.
  • Word Cloud Generator (From Text or Word Counts, SVG)Paste raw text or "word count" lines and get a packed word cloud as SVG: frequent words are larger. Common English stop words can be skipped. Same input and seed give the same layout.
  • Bubble Chart Maker (X, Y and Size as Circle Area)Plot three numeric columns: X and Y set the position, the third value sets the circle area. An optional label column names the bubbles. Accessible SVG with a data table.
  • Waterfall Chart Maker (Running Total of Gains and Losses)Enter a starting value then gains and losses. Floating bars show how each step moves the running total. Leave a value blank to insert a subtotal bar. Colours are paired with + and - signs.
  • Pictogram (Icon Array) Maker for ProportionsShow a share as a grid of icons with part of them highlighted, such as 3 in 10 people. Fractions fill part of the last icon. Pick an icon, count, colour and columns; get an SVG with a text equivalent.
  • Sparkline Generator (Tiny Inline SVG Trend Charts)Paste a series of numbers and get a small line, area or bar sparkline as SVG, sized to sit in text or a table cell. Copy the markup. Includes an accessible name with start, end, min and max.
  • Parallel Coordinates Plot with Range FiltersEach numeric column becomes a vertical axis and each row a line across them. Filter rows by typing a range per column (the keyboard version of brushing); matching lines are coloured, others fade.
  • Bar Chart Race Animator (Animated SVG, Pausable)Rows are time periods and columns are items. Bars re-sort and grow from period to period as a looping CSS-animated SVG you can pause. This makes an animated SVG, not a WebM video.
  • Choropleth World Map Maker (Colour Countries from a CSV)Paste country names or ISO codes with a value and get a world map with each country shaded by its value, a classed legend and a table. Country shapes are bundled (Natural Earth 1:110m, public domain), so nothing is fetched from elsewhere.

Spreadsheet & Data Cleaning (20)

  • Several CSVs to One Excel Workbook (One Sheet Each)Paste several CSV tables separated by a line of --- and download an .xlsx with each table on its own sheet. Name a sheet with a first line "-- name: Sales". Numbers become numeric cells; values with leading zeros stay text.
  • CSV Merger (Stack Files, Align Columns by Header Name)Paste several CSV tables separated by a line of --- and stack their rows into one table. Columns are matched by header name, so files with different column order or extra columns line up; missing cells stay empty.
  • CSV Splitter (Parts of N Rows with Header, as ZIP)Split a large CSV into numbered parts with a fixed number of data rows. Every part repeats the header row, and all parts are bundled in a ZIP.
  • Duplicate Row Remover (By Selected Columns, CSV)Choose which columns define a duplicate (or all), keep the first or last occurrence, optionally ignore case and spaces, and see which rows were removed.
  • CSV Column Splitter (One Column into Several by a Separator)Split one CSV column on a separator such as a comma, space or slash. "Smith, John" becomes a surname and a first-name column. Other columns stay in place.
  • CSV Column Merger (Join Columns into One with a Separator)Concatenate several CSV columns into a new column with a separator you choose, for example street, postcode and city into one address. Empty parts are skipped.
  • CSV Whitespace Trimmer (Trim and Collapse Spaces in Every Cell)Remove leading and trailing spaces in all cells and collapse repeated spaces, tabs and non-breaking spaces to one space. Reports how many cells changed.
  • Pivot Table Builder (Rows, Columns, Sum, Count, Average)Summarise a CSV as a cross-tab: choose the row field, an optional column field, the value field and sum, count, average, min or max. Totals included. Typed field names replace drag and drop.
  • Table Joiner (VLOOKUP-Style Join of Two CSVs on a Key)Join two CSV tables on a key column: inner, left, right or full join. Columns from both tables appear in one result; clashing names get a suffix. Unmatched rows are counted.
  • Fuzzy Match Deduplicator (Cluster Near-Duplicate Names)Group values of a column that differ only by case, punctuation, spacing, company suffixes or small typos ("Acme Inc" and "ACME Inc."). Each group gets its most frequent spelling as the canonical one, and you can output the cleaned CSV.
  • Date Format Normalizer for a CSV Column (Mixed Formats to ISO)Rewrite a column of mixed date styles such as 03/04/21, 4 March 2021 and March 4, 2021 into one format. You set the day-month order for all-numeric dates; ambiguous and unreadable values are reported, not guessed.
  • Phone Number Normalizer to E.164 (CSV Column, Default Country)Convert phone numbers written in local styles to E.164 (+countrycode and digits) for a CSV column, using a default country for numbers without a country code. Numbers whose length does not fit are flagged for review.
  • Missing Value Filler (Constant, Mean, Median, Forward Fill)Fill empty cells per column with a fixed value, the column mean or median, or the previous or next non-empty value. Set a default method and override single columns.
  • Outlier Detector for a CSV Column (IQR or Z-Score Flag)Flag numeric outliers in a column with the Tukey IQR fences or a z-score threshold. Adds a flag column so you can filter, and lists the limits used.
  • Wide to Long Reshaper (Unpivot and Pivot Back)Unpivot a wide table, such as one column per year, into long name and value pairs while keeping identifier columns. The reverse mode spreads a long table back out to wide.
  • Spreadsheet Diff (Added, Removed and Changed Cells by Key)Compare an old and a new CSV table, matching rows by a key column or by position. Added rows, removed rows and changed cells are listed and colour-coded, with signs so colour is not the only cue.
  • Random Row Sampler (Seeded Sample from a CSV)Draw a random sample of rows from a CSV by count or percentage, with an optional seed so you can repeat the draw. Sampling is without replacement and keeps the original row order.
  • Column Statistics Summarizer (Mean, Median, Min, Max, Stdev per Column)Summarise every numeric column of a CSV in one table: count, missing, mean, median, min, max and sample standard deviation. Text columns are listed with their distinct count.
  • Find and Replace in Selected CSV Columns (Regex)Apply a regular expression find and replace to chosen columns of a CSV only. See how many cells changed and which, before you copy the result. $1 style groups work.
  • Category Value Mapper (Standardise Messy Labels)List every distinct value of a column with its count, then map messy labels to standard ones with "old => new" lines. The mapping is applied to all rows; unmapped values stay as they are.

Maps & Geo (14)

  • Coordinate Format Converter (Decimal, DMS, UTM, MGRS, Plus Code)Enter a position as decimal degrees, degrees-minutes-seconds, UTM, MGRS or a Plus Code and see it in all of them, one line per input. Offline maths on the WGS 84 ellipsoid.
  • Plus Code (Open Location Code) Encoder, Decoder and Short-Code RecoveryTurn latitude and longitude into a Plus Code, decode a Plus Code into its area, or expand a short code such as "9G8F+6W" using a nearby reference location. Works offline.
  • Path Distance Calculator (Great-Circle Length of a Route from Coordinates)Paste a list of coordinates to get the length of each leg and the total, with initial bearings. Great-circle (haversine) on a sphere, or the more exact Vincenty ellipsoid method; units km, miles or nautical miles.
  • Midpoint and Centre Finder for Several CoordinatesGive two or more coordinates and get the great-circle midpoint (for two points), the geographic centre of gravity and each point's distance from it. Use it to pick a fair meeting point once you have the coordinates.
  • Radius Circle Generator (GeoJSON Polygon and SVG Around a Point)Enter a centre and a radius and get a circle as a GeoJSON polygon (accurate great-circle points), its bounding box and area, plus an SVG preview. Add several radii for rings.
  • Sun Times Table with Twilight and Polar Day for Date RangesEnter a location (latitude, longitude), a date and a time zone and get sunrise, sunset, solar noon, day length and civil, nautical and astronomical twilight, offline from the NOAA solar equations. Polar day and night are handled.
  • Sun Path Calculator (Azimuth and Elevation Through the Day, Polar Chart)See where the Sun is in the sky at a location through a day: azimuth (compass direction) and elevation every 10 to 60 minutes, rise and set directions, and a sky-dome SVG. Useful for solar panels, shade and photography.
  • GeoJSON Viewer and Validator (SVG Plot, Stats and Problems)Paste GeoJSON to validate it and see points, lines and polygons plotted without a map service, with feature counts, bounding box, lengths, areas and a list of problems such as swapped coordinates or unclosed rings. Edit the text and run again.
  • KML, GPX and GeoJSON Converter (Any Direction)Convert between KML, GPX and GeoJSON in your browser. The input format is detected; pick the target. Placemarks, waypoints, routes, tracks, polygons with holes and extra properties are kept where the target format allows it.
  • GPX Track Analyzer (Distance, Elevation Profile, Time and Speed)Paste or load a GPX file from a watch or app and get distance, elevation gain and loss, highest and lowest point, time, moving speed, a track plot and an elevation profile. No map tiles are loaded.
  • Waypoint List to GPX Route or Track FileType or paste your waypoints as latitude, longitude and an optional name, and download a GPX file as a route, a track or plain waypoints for a GPS device or app. Distance of the route is shown. No map clicking needed.
  • CSV Coordinates to Map Plotter (Points on a Country-Outline Map)Plot the rows of a CSV that has latitude and longitude columns as markers on an offline map made of country outlines. Optional label and size columns. Exports SVG. No street map is loaded.
  • Travel Map Pinner (Mark Visited Countries and Count Them)Click countries on a world map, or tick them in the list, to mark where you have been. Shows how many countries and what share of the map you have visited and lets you download the map as SVG. Nothing is sent anywhere.
  • Geography Quiz: Countries on a Blank World MapPractise where countries are. Find the named country by clicking the map, or name the country that is highlighted by typing its name (the keyboard route). Choose a continent, keep score, and see the right answer after each miss.

Math & Science (28)

  • Function Grapher with Roots and IntersectionsPlot one or more functions of x, with the roots and the points where two curves cross marked and listed.
  • Scientific Calculator with Degrees and CODATA ConstantsEvaluate full expressions with trig (degrees or radians), logs, factorials, variables and physical constants that show their NIST source.
  • Equation Solver: Linear, Quadratic and Polynomial Roots with StepsSolve an equation in one variable, such as 2x^2 + 3x - 5 = 0, with each step and the real and complex roots.
  • Symbolic Derivative Calculator with Rule-by-Rule StepsDifferentiate a function of x symbolically, see which rule is applied at each level, and get the simplified result.
  • Integral Calculator: Antiderivative, Definite Integral and Shaded AreaFind the antiderivative of common functions and the value of a definite integral, with a numeric cross-check and a plot of the area.
  • 3D Surface Plotter z = f(x, y)Draw a surface z = f(x, y) as a shaded 3D mesh and turn it by setting the azimuth and elevation angles.
  • Prime Factorization and Primality Test (Big Integers)Test whether numbers are prime and factor them into primes in exponent form, with divisor count, divisor sum and Euler totient.
  • GCD and LCM Calculator with Euclidean Algorithm StepsGreatest common divisor and least common multiple of two or more integers, with each division step of the Euclidean algorithm.
  • Significant Figures Counter and RounderCount the significant figures in numbers and round them to a chosen number of figures, shown in plain and scientific notation.
  • Regression Calculator: Linear, Polynomial, Exponential, Power and Log FitsFit a model to x, y data and get the equation, R squared, residuals and a plot of the curve over your points.
  • Probability Distribution Calculator and Plot: Normal, Binomial, PoissonPick a normal, binomial or Poisson distribution, set its parameters and an interval, and get the probability with a shaded plot.
  • Molar Mass Calculator from a Chemical Formula (IUPAC Atomic Weights)Molar mass in g/mol from a formula such as Ca(OH)2 or CuSO4.5H2O, with each element contribution, percent by mass and IUPAC uncertainty.
  • Chemical Equation Balancer (Smallest Whole-Number Coefficients)Balance a reaction such as Fe + O2 = Fe2O3 by exact linear algebra and see the atom count on both sides.
  • Periodic Table with IUPAC Atomic Weights, Blocks and SearchSee the table colored by block or atomic weight, search elements by symbol, name or number, and read their weight, period, group and block.
  • Geometry Calculator: Area, Perimeter, Volume and Surface of 16 ShapesPick a shape, enter its dimensions and get area, perimeter, volume or surface area with the formula used for each result.
  • Triangle Solver: SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS and the Ambiguous SSA CaseEnter any three known sides and angles and get the missing ones with area, perimeter, radii and a scaled drawing.
  • Planet and Moon Size Comparator (True Relative Scale)Pick planets, the Moon, Pluto or the Sun and see them side by side at true relative size with diameters and size ratios.
  • Projectile Motion Calculator: Range, Height, Flight Time and PathSet launch speed, angle and height for Earth, Moon or other planets and get range, maximum height, time of flight, impact speed and the path.
  • Pendulum Simulator: Simple and Double Pendulum with Exact PeriodSimulate a simple or double pendulum from length, gravity and starting angle, and plot the angles over time with the period.
  • DC Circuit Solver: Voltages, Currents and Power from a NetlistDescribe a circuit of resistors, voltage sources and current sources as a netlist and get every node voltage, branch current and power.
  • Wave Interference Simulator: Superposition of Two Sine WavesSet amplitude, frequency and phase of two waves and see each wave and their sum, with constructive or destructive interference and beats.
  • Orbital Mechanics Sandbox: N-Body Gravity Simulation with Orbit TrailsEnter bodies with mass, position and velocity, and the tool integrates their mutual gravity and draws the orbit trails.
  • Conway's Game of Life Simulator with Pattern DetectionDraw a starting grid as text, run any number of generations and see the population, snapshots and whether it dies out or settles into a cycle.
  • Molecule Viewer for PDB and XYZ Files (Ball-and-Stick, Space-Filling)Paste PDB or XYZ coordinates and see the molecule as a ball-and-stick or space-filling drawing that you turn with azimuth and elevation angles.
  • Fractal Explorer: Mandelbrot, Julia and Burning Ship SetsRender the Mandelbrot, Julia or Burning Ship set at any center and zoom with a chosen iteration count and palette, and save it as a PNG.
  • Night Sky Viewer (Stars, Moon and Planets Overhead)Draw the sky above any place and time: Yale Bright Star Catalogue stars to magnitude 5, the Sun, Moon phase and the planets, as an all-sky SVG chart plus a table of altitude and azimuth. Computed in your browser.
  • Geometry Construction Board: Points, Lines, Circles and Dependent ConstructionsBuild compass-and-straightedge style constructions from typed commands, forms or the pointer. Dependent points follow when you move a free point. Exports SVG and a text description.
  • LaTeX Equation Renderer to SVG (TeX Layout Rules)Typeset a LaTeX math formula to a scalable SVG: fractions, scripts, roots, sums and integrals with limits, Greek, delimiters, matrices, cases and accents. Layout follows TeX rules and Computer Modern metrics.
